Peter,

Our country is facing a devastating gun violence epidemic. Firearm-related deaths are on the rise, and guns are now the _leading cause of death among American children._ This is devastating and unacceptable.

Kim knows something needs to be done to save lives and keep our communities safe. That's why she was proud to help pass a bipartisan, common sense gun safety bill last month, which President Biden signed into law.

This critical legislation will help address the gun violence epidemic. It provides incentives for states to pass red flag laws. It prevents people convicted of domestic abuse against their dating partners from owning a gun. And, it expands background checks on people aged 18 to 21 who want to purchase a firearm.

While this legislation is a step in the right direction, we still have more work ahead of us. Kim will continue fighting in Congress to keep communities across the country safe from gun violence. And we can't stop demanding action.

| | Fellow American,

When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”

_I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House._

In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. **But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in.**

If we haven't met yet, [**I'm Nancy Mace**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03c8dc3804e042f4858505bda71fe551&_e=MHuxOh1aQim-6mTxQst2ytNRgGyUU_SopfR8ZPnKNL3GA8yGa5bdMkEyO6tQpTJLgKjgEvce92oQk2ndJQ89QnjAbxI7usuL_s6iX0z2AXSeU0nVC-ZRHwXV4ddTdkwSb7xZJOdzIJlC3EkfC0Gh7JMVr2M6mKjIPtd9cTwGWjEZaK37d1KSDRHSuHwqJqyh4M9wChxkHcb8Rc3kZRfNbsC1PC2K8gJKgCAB6xbhnUNBy6IqsZzTUwt_SQazWXF81l75BG2DbEsQPBTO4KGd1l-O8bSGdK-UKYWFy9VFk97nrT16Y-HLH1qsAAovtT-uwQV2DZtFdq-QY3h_7BlkRAIO2JS6MaiI0UX3r1UvurTf4UUM4-R8uCk0J0h_cQi-PEXxakM_W4I7Q1Z83GI8ZXAZ6zmi9nd8X3yu02t9SZWBSsvjxCIfnTLK679P9S9R17j-Ivno7uwlhJ7zR-QeVw%3D%3D). I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America!

I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina.

In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red.

**I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as[we continue on the path to re-election](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03c8dc3804e042f4858505bda71fe551&_e=MHuxOh1aQim-6mTxQst2ytNRgGyUU_SopfR8ZPnKNL3GA8yGa5bdMkEyO6tQpTJLgKjgEvce92oQk2ndJQ89QnjAbxI7usuL_s6iX0z2AXSeU0nVC-ZRHwXV4ddTdkwSb7xZJOdzIJlC3EkfC0Gh7JMVr2M6mKjIPtd9cTwGWjEZaK37d1KSDRHSuHwqJqyh4M9wChxkHcb8Rc3kZRfNbsC1PC2K8gJKgCAB6xbhnUNBy6IqsZzTUwt_SQazWXF8RvzIvfbxFTG_xwE9q9KFkN-dBhMx85wd_sI0ioVL3GYeB6KncGg0NgKxBgwnaL9jb-xEM4CuCXnUoEDiG1IILnKjZvILE4FUQviB5JQ04Isc3IxlZDRneCqpsMNtczkJ2YlKKHn3NRc8P_boeqVp4OntBNJ5hcv7TGTEDtsCwgXeE4m9DB016HQ8mWLXsUNG4vWRWf8Log4wybziIX-rfA%3D%3D).**

[**Will you chip in whatever you can – whether it's $75, $50, or $10, so that I can win this race and restore our country.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03c8dc3804e042f4858505bda71fe551&_e=MHuxOh1aQim-6mTxQst2ytNRgGyUU_SopfR8ZPnKNL3GA8yGa5bdMkEyO6tQpTJLgKjgEvce92oQk2ndJQ89QnjAbxI7usuL_s6iX0z2AXSeU0nVC-ZRHwXV4ddTdkwSb7xZJOdzIJlC3EkfC0Gh7JMVr2M6mKjIPtd9cTwGWjEZaK37d1KSDRHSuHwqJqyh4M9wChxkHcb8Rc3kZRfNbsC1PC2K8gJKgCAB6xbhnUNBy6IqsZzTUwt_SQazWXF8hPeiXqegTzaDUeZPgEDqWTXjCxq-Z00YM08y6bo0blArfo-RcEF4jKOjE0lbeONKuc4r2BHvi40yhtLuYi5GN9s5VdSGJwIre7i0e64AbppN-8iqThiKzVgpBIxSTYpjCviig7h5s28mebcpwe1PFRUTMw_mdfG2M8y48YB2MQD2nfNmquP_4j3RATvHTgGaLPwD082Z_Q7w5x3QcVMYYw%3D%3D)

There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, _let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress._

I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much.

I'm proud of my conservative record and I'm proud of delivering results day in and day out for the Lowcountry. I'm proud I've never voted to raise your taxes. And as the daughter of a veteran, I'm proud of the work I've done to help our veterans throughout South Carolina. **Serving the Lowcountry is the honor of my lifetime.**

[**_Which is why I'm asking for your help to continue doing my job and serving you._** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03c8dc3804e042f4858505bda71fe551&_e=MHuxOh1aQim-6mTxQst2ytNRgGyUU_SopfR8ZPnKNL3GA8yGa5bdMkEyO6tQpTJLgKjgEvce92oQk2ndJQ89QnjAbxI7usuL_s6iX0z2AXSeU0nVC-ZRHwXV4ddTdkwSb7xZJOdzIJlC3EkfC0Gh7JMVr2M6mKjIPtd9cTwGWjEZaK37d1KSDRHSuHwqJqyh4M9wChxkHcb8Rc3kZRfNbsC1PC2K8gJKgCAB6xbhnUNBy6IqsZzTUwt_SQazWXF8mvEW1AjoMeUWJ7bxGVufkI3ywH2FbLT9la_n57lQVaLUEap1OAQ6s7DgjhH-6ESCZpaLtOICe01YfXMjWHAh4pnOKC0JMAo7vl8wow0YRnLdyZzO5X_QaD_aeEMJ5obdcUU8Sq6p1JHqUaAsM05CdxgiVHsG4wnA1RxOcT4tjyG1Q0a31zXdEjBS25ailW5RGH6N9oi2TOyY8DM5-5_fXw%3D%3D) [ ** KEEP THE FIRST ➞ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03c8dc3804e042f4858505bda71fe551&_e=MHuxOh1aQim-6mTxQst2ytNRgGyUU_SopfR8ZPnKNL3GA8yGa5bdMkEyO6tQpTJLgKjgEvce92oQk2ndJQ89QnjAbxI7usuL_s6iX0z2AXSeU0nVC-ZRHwXV4ddTdkwSb7xZJOdzIJlC3EkfC0Gh7JMVr2M6mKjIPtd9cTwGWjEZaK37d1KSDRHSuHwqJqyh4M9wChxkHcb8Rc3kZRfNbsC1PC2K8gJKgCAB6xbhnUNBy6IqsZzTUwt_SQazWXF8IjXs0Ipo3IH0U4YpEksqxwFE3xo2lGoqPlZQDayIyAgZjWoOwD7sOv8guX1Z9zO1kVIwkvVmux6FuXfsS0gyEBJThu6KR4TAtJ6PANDB4vCj_Yh0yjKy6aTST4Fx4Pp7pPPycG6zEETDhh0RvGFb3B5ElCbMt_paGuzHY0GrlNqqZxRXalCXYn0DW9D8ty-vl6MzVra7pNdUZLAFfCqUKA%3D%3D)

What's happening in America right now is _horrifying_. Kids are being used as political pawns, radical liberal ideas are becoming mainstream, the woke media is prioritizing clicks and view over the truth, and our so-called ‘leaders' have sold themselves out for fame and fortune.

As Americans, we deserve __so much better than this__. It's time to restore our economy, secure the southern border, put parents back in charge, support our military, and reestablish pride in our country.

[**It's time to stand up and say enough is enough! I'm running for re-election because I believe I'm the woman who can help save our country.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03c8dc3804e042f4858505bda71fe551&_e=MHuxOh1aQim-6mTxQst2ytNRgGyUU_SopfR8ZPnKNL3GA8yGa5bdMkEyO6tQpTJLgKjgEvce92oQk2ndJQ89QnjAbxI7usuL_s6iX0z2AXSeU0nVC-ZRHwXV4ddTdkwSb7xZJOdzIJlC3EkfC0Gh7JMVr2M6mKjIPtd9cTwGWjEZaK37d1KSDRHSuHwqJqyh4M9wChxkHcb8Rc3kZRfNbsC1PC2K8gJKgCAB6xbhnUNBy6IqsZzTUwt_SQazWXF83GXvD9j57HM3eDedmcrOO2dNC_sTh887tR1a9gSO5cX1WMYUXTEKXhYzlDY-f1tf7XlXqd5bQ39oVAYA960NG0cEM0kaQf6Iny83vdwtsbiWbaikh0xWpJRksmoV00Zy54oKwp19L6XQ2jddIxAHJVxP-B-jKGrNClZFaV4vr_kXE9YhJjreX95gJBjW_2b_CK1SXTlzwv0bm3x12RvXPw%3D%3D) I'm in Washington week in and week out, fighting for you and your family – I have a 100% record of voting to lower taxes and a 100% lifetime rating with Conservation Voters of South Carolina!

[ ** SEND NANCY TO CONGRESS ➞ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=03c8dc3804e042f4858505bda71fe551&_e=MHuxOh1aQim-6mTxQst2ytNRgGyUU_SopfR8ZPnKNL3GA8yGa5bdMkEyO6tQpTJLgKjgEvce92oQk2ndJQ89QnjAbxI7usuL_s6iX0z2AXSeU0nVC-ZRHwXV4ddTdkwSb7xZJOdzIJlC3EkfC0Gh7JMVr2M6mKjIPtd9cTwGWjEZaK37d1KSDRHSuHwqJqyh4M9wChxkHcb8Rc3kZRfNbsC1PC2K8gJKgCAB6xbhnUNBy6IqsZzTUwt_SQazWXF8JwSMQpq4igISFOF7foy2MNU7BdzlfVtxaP0x96-4xpPxnpZXl84jHhxgWLafr2UbNbsrq_-A170aCiaEjN8arvLYK90iYhaB17kYmz1UnWPVz6ypz4MTjKZa8AstvtAN5IEWWO3iQHpVu3cEgs9RNxJA_ogQV4Emu8k9mnd3E2ixd7FMdlkYZP4B-TWsqxQV0MbbeWl6Q8lmGnRhQWtm8g%3D%3D)

I'll leave you with this thought: I believe you can do anything you set your mind to. That's how a high-school drop-out like myself became a Congresswoman. _I believe we can fix our country and leave a stronger nation to the next generation._

Maybe it's how I was raised, or maybe it's just the fighting spirit in me, but I know we can fix the broken system in Washington. clean_body: When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you’re going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”| | | | | | Fellow American, When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.” I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House. In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in. If we haven't met yet, . I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America! I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina. In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red. I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as. There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress. I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much. I'm proud of my conservative record and I'm proud of delivering results day in and day out for the Lowcountry. I'm proud I've never voted to raise your taxes. And as the daughter of a veteran, I'm proud of the work I've done to help our veterans throughout South Carolina. Serving the Lowcountry is the honor of my lifetime. What's happening in America right now is horrifying. Kids are being used as political pawns, radical liberal ideas are becoming mainstream, the woke media is prioritizing clicks and view over the truth, and our so-called ‘leaders' have sold themselves out for fame and fortune. As Americans, we deserve so much better than this. It's time to restore our economy, secure the southern border, put parents back in charge, support our military, and reestablish pride in our country. I'm in Washington week in and week out, fighting for you and your family – I have a 100% record of voting to lower taxes and a 100% lifetime rating with Conservation Voters of South Carolina! I'll leave you with this thought: I believe you can do anything you set your mind to. That's how a high-school drop-out like myself became a Congresswoman. I believe we can fix our country and leave a stronger nation to the next generation. Maybe it's how I was raised, or maybe it's just the fighting spirit in me, but I know we can fix the broken system in Washington. subject: Frustrating
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
Here’s where we stand after last week.
#
Let me explain where we stand after last week’s big Texas Ethics Commission filings.
**Here's the good news:** We OUTRAISED Greg Abbott with more than half a million contributions — and set a new record for the most money raised in a single reporting period by a state-level candidate in Texas history!
**But here's the bad news:** Thanks to his corporate mega-donors and special interests, Abbott still has more cash to spend in this election. We know for a fact that he plans to spend over $100 million against Beto before Election Day.

There’s so much at stake in this election, and we can’t let Abbott’s corporate mega-donors drown out Beto’s unifying message.
**[Can you make your very first donation to Beto’s people-powered campaign for Governor today? The future of Texas is on the line.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220718-2.qFOdk1&refcode=ema20220718-199018&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=199018%2E444211%2EQHHMyc)**
**[Donate Now »](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220718-2.qFOdk1&refcode=ema20220718-199018&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=199018%2E444211%2EQHHMyc)**
This race will be one of the most competitive — and expensive — in Texas history. But while Abbott calls up his large corporate donors for check after check, we'll be focused on delivering for the people of Texas.
**Because the people of Texas are with us.** They reject Abbott’s extreme positions on abortion and guns, the hatred he stokes towards Texans, and his blatant attacks on their rights. That’s why his support has fallen below 50% — shockingly low for an incumbent. And it’s why 59% of Texans say the state is on the WRONG track.
While Abbott tries to divide us, Beto is focused on building a big, inclusive vision for Texas that encompasses everyone, _but we need this grassroots movement to have his back if we’re going to win_.
**[Will you donate $3 to help elect Beto and defeat Greg Abbott?](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220718-2.qFOdk1&refcode=ema20220718-199018&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=199018%2E444211%2EQHHMyc)**
Your support means so much to us.
Thank you,
Nick Rathod

But it goes more than just the gasoline. It goes into our asphalt, into the buttons in our shirts, into our phones. It's almost in everything that we produce. But this is what started the rise in inflation. body:
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-qalhdt-ttjjilthht-r/) Hi Peter, **It is my great pleasure to announce my pick for Lt. Governor,****Danny Moore! ** Danny and I share a common vision to lower Colorado's soaring cost of living, gas prices, crime rates, and a commitment to making our children the priority. Together we will undo Jared Polis' far-left policies that continue to make it impossible for hard-working Coloradans to make ends meet. **We are mission focused on delivering what is best for Colorado together.** _**Danny Moore**_ Danny is a Centennial resident and has lived in Arapahoe County for 25 years. He served 24 years in the United States Navy before retiring in 2005. He served in several challenging leadership positions throughout his Naval career, with his final assignment being Senior Enlisted Advisor within the Aerospace Data Facility Colorado.He was only the second Navy personnel to hold the position in the facility's history. Danny is the first Black male to achieve the rank of CTTCM (Cryptologic Technician Technical Master Chief). name: Bryan Steil, Congressman
subject: READ: New article about my campaign's efforts in Beloit
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY STEIL FOR WISCONSIN, INC
body:
Peter, I am hard at work campaigning in Beloit, a new part of the First Congressional District, because we will not leave any vote on the table. It’s my priority.
Hi Peter,**I am hard at work campaigning in Beloit, a new part of the First Congressional District, because we will not leave any vote on the table. It 's my priority.**In Beloit, I hear about issues that are a focus to voters across the state. The cost of groceries and gas, crime, and education are all front of mind for voters._Our team is working hard in Beloit and the new areas of the district as we work to earn every vote and win in November._ Read more about our efforts to bring a Red Wave to Beloit this November below or on the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel's website **[here](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-r/)**.Want to help fuel our campaign efforts in Beloit? Click here to **[donate](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-y/)** or **[volunteer](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-j/)**. BELOIT - U.S. Rep. Bryan Steil stood outside a Clark Gas & Oil less than a quarter-mile from the Illinois border and scanned the line of cars waiting for an open pump. When someone with a Wisconsin license plate pulled up, he'd wait for the driver to begin pumping gas before approaching and giving a familiar introduction."Can I introduce myself?" Steil asked customers at the gas station one evening in late June. "I'm Congressman Bryan Steil. I'm running for reelection, and I represent this area now." Nearly every time, he'd ask how much it costs to fill up the car's tank."This thing? You don't even want to know," said one man with a Hummer. Another woman said it costs her $74 to fill up her car. It used to be about $46. "You trying to lower food prices, too?" she asked. "One hundred percent," Steil responded. This wasn't the first time the Janesville Republican could be seen hanging around a gas station in the Rock County border city. Steil spent a handful of afternoons over the last several months at the pumps in Beloit -- putting in what he calls "a lot of shoe leather" in an attempt to win over residents in the Democratic city, which became part of his 1st Congressional District under new maps approved earlier this year.The stops are part of the second-term congressman's strategy to connect with voters during an election year that will be, at least on paper, more challenging for him than those of the past.The addition of the historically blue city of Beloit and the removal of the Republican suburbs of southern Waukesha County from the 1st District during redistricting shifted Steil's seat from solid red to more purple, much like it was in the 1990s.Now, with the seat more competitive, Democrats hope the blue precincts added to the district and recent hot-button issues like abortion can energize voters to flip the seat at the same time they [battle to hang on to western Wisconsin's 3rd congressional district](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-t/)."I think that voters in Rock County and the 1st CD really don't see any action coming from Bryan Steil," said Democratic Party of Rock County Chairman Shawn Reents. "And we're looking for somebody who is actually going to go out there and do something." Still, Steil is favored in November over his Democratic opponent Ann Roe, whom he has outraised by a factor of about 5.5 to 1, according to campaign finance reports released last week. The nonpartisan Cook Political Report [rated the district "solid Republican"](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-i/) during a midterm cycle seen as favorable to the GOP. But Steil indicated he still plans to get out in Beloit and have conversations "about the direction that we want to take our country." He's doing that largely by hitting on issues like gas prices, crime and education, where he hopes to differentiate himself from what he sees as Democratic inaction while not alienating himself from the majority of the city's voters. "I'm excited," Steil told the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel when asked about Beloit becoming part of the 1st. "I think that people in Beloit, like people across Wisconsin, have been punched in the face by the policies of the left.""I think people are ready to listen to an alternative path that has not been the vote of this community in the past," he added. "I'm optimistic."
## **'A real opportunity'**
At the gas station in late June, Steil handed out cards with the words "Working for You. Delivering Results." On either side of the flyer, he pledged to work to lower gas prices by "unleashing American energy independence," something he's [often tweeted about](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-d/) in the past few months. He said oil and natural gas are necessary as the U.S. continues to transition toward clean energy sources like solar and wind, and he attributed the recent high gas prices to a supply problem, deriding the Biden administration for actions like [killing the Keystone XL pipeline](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-h/) and not tapping into new oil sources."They've been actively working on rules and regulations that restrict domestic supply," Steil said. "... It's a full-blown, intentional policy of this administration to increase the cost of oil and natural gas."The Biden administration has blamed the high prices, in part, on Russia's invasion of Ukraine and recently called on Congress to temporarily suspend the federal gas tax. House Democrats in May passed a bill [targeting price gouging](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-k/), and Wisconsin's delegation was divided along party lines on the legislation. Steil said the bill was a way to "score political points" and not address the supply problem. Inside the convenience store, however, Rajeshkumar Patel, the gas station's owner, told the Journal Sentinel he does not know why gas prices are high. But he, too, feels the effects. Fewer people buy food and drinks and other items from the store when gas is expensive, Patel said. He has had to increase the price of those items so he can keep his station running. "The price going up is everywhere," said Patel. "The grocery store, every place you go. Everything is going up." The of gas at Patel's station has decreased about 30 cents in the past couple weeks.Public safety is another integral part of Steil's pitch to Beloit voters. He said crime has increased "across the board" in the city, noting there are shootings and claiming drugs like fentanyl are also an issue.Patel said he's heard more gunshots around the gas station in recent years. And one Beloit resident, Alex Jimenez, told the Journal Sentinel he was surprised to see the congressman near the gas station on Broad Street and Park Avenue."You could get shot over here," Jimenez said. "It's a bad area. Down the street, a couple streets down, there's always shootings."Data from the Beloit Police Department show homicides in the city increased from two in 2020 to four in 2021. The number of instances of assault increased by 46 over the same period. The city recorded three homicides in the first four months of 2022, according to the public police data. The solution to these problems, according to Steil, is to provide resources to local law enforcement. "I think that is going to be a real opportunity," he said, "to distinguish the policies from the right from, in particular, this administration and those on the far left calling to defund the police."Schools in Beloit have also been challenged, Steil said, referencing the School District of Beloit's one-star rating from the Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction. He touted charter schools and school choice as answers -- something Roe, his Democratic opponent who lectured at the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater for about 20 years, slammed as "not a productive option."The School District of Beloit did not respond to requests for an interview.
## **Democrats still optimistic**
Despite the headwinds, Democrats remain optimistic for November in the 1st District. Elsewhere in the state, the party isn't putting up a fight in more heavily Republican-leaning districts. Democrats [failed to field a candidate](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-n/) in two such districts -- the 6th, represented by Glenn Grothman, and the 8th, represented by Mike Gallagher.Reents, the Rock County Democrats chair, noted the changes to the 1st district map and said they give his party "a really good opportunity" to carry the district. He called Roe, who has said her priorities are bringing more jobs to the district and expanding affordable health care, a "great candidate."Roe, who is originally from Chicago, has spent the last 27 years in Janesville. In addition to lecturing in the past, Roe owns Custom College Solutions, a service that helps high school students prepare for college. "I have enjoyed success at the teaching level. I have enjoyed success at the community level," Roe told the Journal Sentinel. "And what I want to see moving forward, I know that I need that federal platform to get that work done and get all of our communities and people represented."State Rep. Mark Spreitzer, a Democrat from Beloit, echoed Democrats' hopes. He noted the city is diverse, with a significant Black and a growing Hispanic population -- groups he doesn't think Steil is "in step" with. Spreitzer acknowledged the issues of high gas prices, crime and education in Beloit but emphasized that gas prices have fallen in the last few weeks. Beloit's school district needs stable leadership, he added, and a bigger investment in the schools."If a congressional candidate wants to talk about our public schools, I hope they're talking about how to bring home more federal support to help us actually give students the education that they deserve," Spreitzer said. He added: "This is obviously a slightly Republican-leaning district, and so we probably need something to break Democrats' way to win the district this year. I certainly hope that will happen."And for Steil, Beloit is no stranger. He worked in the city for eight years as counsel for a manufacturing company not far from Clark Gas & Oil. And, he said, there are a lot of people in the city whom he has known for a long time. "I'm down here," Steil said. "I'm going to put in a lot of shoe leather to get out, talk to people and earn their vote."Thank you for reading! I appreciate your support. On Wisconsin,Bryan
--
**Bryan Steil**
Congressman [Help Us Fight Back!](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-p/) [](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-x/)[](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-m/)[](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-c/) [ Forward ](https://steilforwisconsininc.forwardtomyfriend.com/j-idtjvlhlh-C89B6A88-vjrbo-l-a) | PAID FOR BY STEIL FOR WISCONSIN, INC

MAILING ADDRESS:
STEIL FOR WISCONSIN
1818 MILTON AVE. #1448
JANESVILLE, WI 53545 [Read our Privacy Policy](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-q/) You are receiving this email as you are subscribed for expressing interest in campaign updates from Steil for Wisconsin Inc.

For internal use only: RD493 [Preferences](https://steilforwisconsininc.updatemyprofile.com/j-vjrbo-C89B6A88-idtjvlhlh-f) | [Unsubscribe](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-u-vjrbo-idtjvlhlh-z/)

Fewer people buy food and drinks and other items from the store when gas is expensive, Patel said. He has had to increase the price of those items so he can keep his station running. "The price going up is everywhere," said Patel. "The grocery store, every place you go. Everything is going up." The of gas at Patel's station has decreased about 30 cents in the past couple weeks.Public safety is another integral part of Steil's pitch to Beloit voters. He said crime has increased "across the board" in the city, noting there are shootings and claiming drugs like fentanyl are also an issue.Patel said he's heard more gunshots around the gas station in recent years. And one Beloit resident, Alex Jimenez, told the Journal Sentinel he was surprised to see the congressman near the gas station on Broad Street and Park Avenue."You could get shot over here," Jimenez said. "It's a bad area. Down the street, a couple streets down, there's always shootings."Data from the Beloit Police Department show homicides in the city increased from two in 2020 to four in 2021. The number of instances of assault increased by 46 over the same period. The city recorded three homicides in the first four months of 2022, according to the public police data. The solution to these problems, according to Steil, is to provide resources to local law enforcement. "I think that is going to be a real opportunity," he said, "to distinguish the policies from the right from, in particular, this administration and those on the far left calling to defund the police."Schools in Beloit have also been challenged, Steil said, referencing the School District of Beloit's one-star rating from the Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction. He touted charter schools and school choice as answers -- something Roe, his Democratic opponent who lectured at the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater for about 20 years, slammed as "not a productive option."The School District of Beloit did not respond to requests for an interview. Democrats still optimistic Despite the headwinds, Democrats remain optimistic for November in the 1st District. Elsewhere in the state, the party isn't putting up a fight in more heavily Republican-leaning districts. Democrats in two such districts -- the 6th, represented by Glenn Grothman, and the 8th, represented by Mike Gallagher.Reents, the Rock County Democrats chair, noted the changes to the 1st district map and said they give his party "a really good opportunity" to carry the district. He called Roe, who has said her priorities are bringing more jobs to the district and expanding affordable health care, a "great candidate."Roe, who is originally from Chicago, has spent the last 27 years in Janesville. In addition to lecturing in the past, Roe owns Custom College Solutions, a service that helps high school students prepare for college. "I have enjoyed success at the teaching level. I have enjoyed success at the community level," Roe told the Journal Sentinel. "And what I want to see moving forward, I know that I need that federal platform to get that work done and get all of our communities and people represented."State Rep. Mark Spreitzer, a Democrat from Beloit, echoed Democrats' hopes. He noted the city is diverse, with a significant Black and a growing Hispanic population -- groups he doesn't think Steil is "in step" with. Spreitzer acknowledged the issues of high gas prices, crime and education in Beloit but emphasized that gas prices have fallen in the last few weeks. Beloit's school district needs stable leadership, he added, and a bigger investment in the schools."If a congressional candidate wants to talk about our public schools, I hope they're talking about how to bring home more federal support to help us actually give students the education that they deserve," Spreitzer said. He added: "This is obviously a slightly Republican-leaning district, and so we probably need something to break Democrats' way to win the district this year. I certainly hope that will happen."And for Steil, Beloit is no stranger. He worked in the city for eight years as counsel for a manufacturing company not far from Clark Gas & Oil. And, he said, there are a lot of people in the city whom he has known for a long time. "I'm down here," Steil said. "I'm going to put in a lot of shoe leather to get out, talk to people and earn their vote."Thank you for reading! I appreciate your support. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. name: Deirdre Gilbert
subject: Holding Accountable Election Authorities
body:
# We Must Hold Election Authorities Accountable
**Houston, TX --** Deirdre Gilbert filed a lawsuit on July 11, 2022 in the District Court, 353rd, Judicial District, Travis County requesting the courts to step in and mandate election officials John B. Scott, Texas Secretary of State and Keith Ingram, Director of Elections to include Gilbert's name on the Official List of Approved Candidates in the November Election.Deirdre Gilbert is alleging that the Secretary of State and employee Keith Ingram, Director of Elections used their legal professions to knowingly and willingly assist in criminal and fraudulent behavior of political candidates. Gilbert states that "deceit, misrepresentation and fraud has resonated throughout the election process and that the role of the accused have played a significant role in exasperating the nightmare." Gilbert has implicated several attorneys for their failure to take further steps that would have eliminated the illegal conduct, but instead they used "willful blindness" or "deliberate ignorance", that is sanctionable under the Rules of Professional Conduct.Gilbert sees that her race for Governor has been oppressed since her first announcement, misleading voters to think that Abbott and O'Rourke are the only ones running for this position. She's read the rules and is determined to use the rules to level the playing field. Texas Election Code states that independent candidates must submit petitions that satisfy a requirement and validity, while major parties can circumvent the law by not filing a filing fee or submitting petitions, by using "ill-gotten means," or using SB 44, a bill signed by Greg Abbott on May 23, 2017, adding that a candidate petition need not be check for validity unless someone files a challenge. The problem with challenging candidates who do not meet statutory requirements is that you have to know that there is a deficiency in the first place."It's a corrupt system where Texas people won't even have the option of voting for someone outside the 2-party system," added Gilbert. "Gilbert says "she will not stop until her name is on the ballot in November."**About Deirdre Gilbert** Gilbert is an African American woman who has worked tirelessly in her community and is simply fed up with the shenanigans of the political atmosphere. She's worked on the denial of voting rights in local elections within Missouri City and MUD District issues. She has spoken before the Texas Legislature and U.S. Congress in Washington D.C on civil rights. Gilbert has helped shape legislation regarding whistleblowers, medical malpractice, and education. Deirdre Gilbert is not afraid of a battle and is willing to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. The core of Gilbert's message is Justice for All. To connect with Gilbert, visit her online at[ https://gilbert4gov.com](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-r/); they can go to[ https://deirdre-gilbert.com](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-y/) or[ https://nmmaa.org](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-j/). Gilbert can also be followed on[ Facebook](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-t/),[ Twitter](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-i/),[ YouTube](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-d/), and[ LinkedIn](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-h/). Contact Campaign Manager at campaignmanager@gilbert4gov.com [Contact Secretary of State Today and Voice Your Concern!](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-k/) | 9119 Highway 6, Suite 230Missouri City, TX 77459 www.gilbert4gov.com [Preferences](https://gilbertforgovernor.updatemyprofile.com/y-buuqll-E305D3C8-iduiyhurdd-u) | [Unsubscribe](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail19.com/t/y-u-buuqll-iduiyhurdd-n/)

name: Tim Scott
subject: This would mean the world to me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SCOTT FOR SENATE
body:
I’m a humble person and hate asking for favors. But I’m nothing without you - I can’t do this on my own. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6263%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=Y57nPY4GJ968zEsjSykefQ&sysid=1)
I’m a humble person and hate asking for favors. But I’m nothing without you - I can’t do this on my own.

|
---
| | | Friend, it’s Tim Scott. I only have a minute so I’m going to get straight to the point.

I grew up in a single-parent household and almost failed out of high school. If it weren’t for my supportive mother and mentors, who knows where I would be today.

The American Dream - the possibility of going from cotton to Congress - was never guaranteed to me. Now, I’m committed to making sure that every child has the same opportunities regardless of which side of the tracks they grew up on.

But listen, Friend, winning this fight is impossible without your support.

Friend, it would be an honor if you continued to support me - can you spare $10 to help me continue my fight in the Senate?

---
| | | [I'LL CHIP IN $10](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64683%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rzwdvHC9ChgRMhIF01%2bQiw&sysid=1 "I'LL CHIP IN $10")
---

I’m in the Senate to fight for the American dream for all Americans. That means fighting for kids who grow up in circumstances like mine, protecting our God given rights, and expanding opportunities for all Americans regardless of race, gender, age, and political identity.

I’m a humble person and hate asking for favors. But I’m nothing without you - I can’t do this on my own. **Our extended mid-month deadline is TODAY and we can’t waste any more time. We haven’t raised enough to hit our goal, but it’s not too late.**

**[It would mean the world to me if you could stand with me today in my fight for the American Dream.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64684%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IrfGQpEEar6lQO64FA3EcQ&sysid=1 "It would mean the world to
me if you could stand with me today in my fight for the American Dream.")**

Thank you,

Tim Scott

---
| |

subject: Reason with precision
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9492%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=vRVAXGi6PMzGVaRd%2f2BWlg&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38028%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZSOCEYvqqt5J52HhLXxH%2bg&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.** Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because... Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---

I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below: [_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38020%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=v0yKgc%2fUOvyczySQ9CujZA&sysid=1) Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: BLM vs Blexit
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqcbum28lqjlh0cvlpmesk66a2qqqoqgq1bqtneo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onk6mqm3dbgmhqb6orlespjdc9k6cr76cbnclq38s74c3j6ad1mmoorct9lmlimeduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdn6kom0sljcor65cr4cuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zik23nmo60et06hfog6ehnilkjl8dl4i8qugeuoo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zgmd6kknkgjmqv5vn45mu2iikp5lc8oooid42tog_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5uhvceht53mmqf7jgfvpapkdk6etr2qjaipk9so_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsv9ht3ipv5ksq52rg8ic81l43n5c0kv0na9lqj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zcinfus3gvr8i270troe1ab0ijk7a71cqoshg5lg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zi6duvi51pn7jf4vhb4jfk8ueel13hk3urlr8mv8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjulu7e8ej0prlogat9omgauv4fhnihdenschot8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zi545qbhd1kisbvdgt3v01h0kamkiuqn14ompf5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zra5fn6pbs9b04iva91uoto82bust1utktf3udlg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z73kilqapbnmiv2bnt7hga1996nl56qlb5ui84j8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zi0uagd7sjf27i325km8jnoqruk8ogck8jmdudf0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhgctrijuuik4b4k3947dgflg25oo43um4jgap8g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zds2s1qtd634q7l6ufpns95arin0ma3j0tbbdg7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztcrfbcrirgtsjvslp2jldmem8tk1akjuhgv9oh0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zcqnth2oct08ouc1ptdfjb6fstttesjco87gmpoo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd4u6gbe5hn73je1am2k2p2hfane123jtdgg0gqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2tv5054oe85qcsalrrdd3pc2dvj5tt6feaku6cg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z6aetlrteta3gi92kmi8ib3m5hji4dta1trkf3p0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z39ak2t0inbdag7vbskkijs60lpvmtpreirgl3jo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zlm6f8puv5d8jr6ma0ka3edemirr830i8p607olo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zqfb4705oat090dgme73f3co66n4vta9vk8mv0eg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0s9j6co76c3h2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

Friend,
the unholy alliance between big government and woke corporations
is growing and it could not be MORE concerning.

FIGHT
BACK: END ESG >> SIGN OUR PETITION

The
latest and most dangerous attempt to undermine our market and
force a woke agenda on America is called the Environmental,
Social, And Governance Movement (ESG).

ESG rules
are a dangerous form of red-tape regulation. Left-wing activists
want to impose government ESG rules as a way to assert control
over Wall Street and Main Street businesses.

ESG has
been commonly described by the Left as criteria for making
investment decisions to "aid environmental or social causes you
care about." But really, they only want it to benefit causes THEY
care about.

ESG is
essentially a social credit score for businesses that would favor
radical, liberal beliefs and PUNISH pro-American, traditional
values. END ESG NOW >>

How will
the Left punish companies with ESG? With a low ESG score,
companies may not qualify for loans or investments. The Left will
use cancel-culture tactics to pressure other companies to cut
business ties. Government contracts will only go to the "right"
companies with the "right" ESG scores. The Left will deplatform
companies from needed services-like banking, advertising, and
internet services.

Who does
ESG hurt? Everyone! Customers, employees, small businesses, big
businesses, investors, and anyone with a retirement account will
suffer under an ESG regime. We've seen what socialist control of
businesses looks like in China, Venezuela, the USSR-it's not
good!

What kind
of companies would be punished under ESG? American oil and gas
companies. Companies that don't pledge to go 100% green.
Companies that fail to mandate CRT trainings for employees.
Companies that don't push "woke" gender ideology. The list goes
on and on…

And it's
a BIG DEAL! Once you cross the Left, they will use ESG to target
you.

As I
wrote in my latest op-ed, Elon Musk found this out the hard way.
After his public stance on free speech and efforts to purchase
Twitter, his "electric cars, solar, and clean energy" company was
excluded from the ESG index.

ESG is
infecting every level of government and finance: last May,
Biden's pick to lead banking regulation said "the way we
basically get rid of those carbon financiers is we starve them of
their sources of capital." This is the heart of ESG - financially
starving any companies who aren't in line with the progressive
ideology.

We've
already watched as this administration has shuttered pipelines,
denied permits, and cut off development-bank financing for oil
and gas - all in line with the so-called ESG agenda.

At
Heritage Action, we're working to fight back and prevent the
spread of ESG rules and regulations. Through education, activism,
and legislation, we can fight ESG, just like we did CRT (Critical
Race Theory). But we need your support to raise awareness and
STOP ESG!

Will you
join us by signing the petition to END ESG now?
https://heritageaction.com/support/

ESG
policies are nothing but a thinly veiled attempt to radically
transform corporations into social justice warriors and exclude
conservatives from competing in our economy.

We cannot
allow this to continue.

Make your
voice heard by signing your name now.

SIGN YOUR
NAME

Thank you
in advance.

Jessica
Anderson

Action - Executive Director

Peter, look at this old email that I just found!
Four years ago, I was on the brink of making history and becoming the first Black woman _ever_ to hold statewide office in New York. I knew what kind of attorney general I wanted to be – one who was unflinchingly afraid to take on the powerful and corrupt in order to defend the vulnerable – but I realize now that I truly didn’t know what was in store for me.
Now, four years later, I’ve successfully taken on Big Pharma, gun manufacturers and producers, predatory landlords, and _more_. I’ve been able to accomplish more than I could’ve ever imagined possible in my first term – but, with GOP extremists attacking some of our most basic rights, my work is nowhere near finished.
**Peter, I’m up for re-election in November and I’m not done fighting for you! I grew up the daughter of a maid and a janitor, living with my six siblings in a two-bedroom, A-frame home in Jacksonville. With a lot of hard work, I became the first in my family to graduate college – and then, I entered the police academy at a time when there were hardly any Black women working as officers.
People told me I didn't belong in the force, but I risked my life to protect my community, working the night shifts as a beat cop. Years later, I became the first woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.
I'm no stranger to adversity, friend. That's why it doesn't faze me when people like the chair of the Republican National Committee attack me personally, or when the GOP launches desperate attack ads to defeat me.******I always keep my eye on the prize, but the truth is I know I can't win this race alone. Val Demings

subject: Operation Beloit - Volunteer Opportunity

body:
Team Steil will launch a door-knocking operation in Beloit on Wednesday, July 20th. We will meet at Riverside Park in Beloit at 1 PM before heading out on doors. The team will be gathering in the main parking lot.
Hi Peter,Team Steil will launch a door-knocking operation in Beloit on Wednesday, July 20th. We will meet at Riverside Park in Beloit at 1 PM before heading out on doors. The team will be gathering in the main parking lot. **Operation Beloit** Our mission is to bring a Red Wave to Beloit this November. Team Steil is working hard in this new part of the First Congressional District to spread awareness about the election in November. Will you help us? **If you are interested in volunteering on Wednesday for Operation Beloit, please email me at[ James@SteilForWisconsin.com](mailto:James@SteilForWisconsin.com).**If you can't make it Wednesday but would like to help Team Steil in the future, please let us know by emailing me or by visiting Bryan's campaign website [here](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-r/). You can also donate to help Bryan bring a Red Wave to Beloit by clicking [here](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-y/). Every dollar helps. **Bryan has made it a priority to campaign and talk with people in Beloit about the challenges impacting them.** The cost of groceries, gas prices, crime, and education are all top concerns. _Below is a _[recent article](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-j/) _highlighting Bryan 's efforts to bring a Red Wave to Beloit and show that conservative policies work. _ [](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-t/) **Door Knocking Tips:**
* Wear comfortable shoes
* Bring Water - it's going to be hot!
* Make sure your phone is charged - Team Steil will help you download walk books on Campaign Sidekick
* Campaign t-shirts will be provided for volunteers who are going out on doors

For your awareness, after door-knocking, the GOP Wisconsin Victory Team will host a Grassroots Training at the Beloit Public Library from 6:00 - 7:00 PM on Wednesday evening, July 20th. You can find information about the event [here](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-i/).We look forward to seeing you in Beloit! Best,James
--
**James Langnes**
Campaign Manager [](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-d/)[](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-h/)[](https://email.rally.digital/t/j-l-vjrlklt-idtjvlhlh-k/) [ Forward ](https://steilforwisconsininc.forwardtomyfriend.com/j-idtjvlhlh-C89B6A88-vjrlklt-l-p) | PAID FOR BY STEIL FOR WISCONSIN, INC

STEIL FOR WISCONSIN
1818 MILTON AVE. #1448

subject: They want to destroy our country
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=9b8329cccd36d4eb5c2947d8b865785cbbc4404621d7690e934de718333a8c4fa8b155244a56794d01e002b7c035c9fba083f1edc784c60fc78fe743583dd42e6f7c677ae4cbfda5

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=95aada538b1e19657f736acec490e83567f25c8e979e86227b9ce7a7193da67d4fdf1bfd5f0be515edc3e27e5cb1082c3acf10ac728786aa

Peter,

When I was elected Governor in 2018, there were nearly 300,000 more Democrats than Republicans registered in the state of Florida.

I was not elected by a landslide – far from it, actually. I was elected because of the hard work of dedicated grassroots supporters who saw that the idea of freedom was under attack in America. I was elected by them and by the grace of God.

Can you imagine how different our state would be right now if freedom had not won in 2018? Over the last three and a half years, Florida has cemented its place as a beachhead of freedom. Florida is a shining example that no matter the circumstances, freedom is always a working model.

We are the state that didn’t turn to tyranny in the face of uncertainty. We led with freedom and empowered our citizens – just as the Founders intended.

As I write to you today, Republicans continue to outpace Democrats in voter registration – and we’re not looking back!We are on track for a HUGE RED WAVE this November, and we must turn up the pressure.

Ten years ago, I decided to run for Congress because I believed the Obama administration was leading in a way which was totally inconsistent with the founding of our great country.

Now, Biden is enacting an agenda that may exceed the destruction of the old Obama agenda. The radical Left in this country is more aggressive than ever before. They no longer conceal that they are committed to destroying America from within.

Rewriting history, support of cultural Marxism, indoctrination rather than education, and sexually explicit material in the classroom with young children – these are days I never imagined seeing in my country and days I refuse to let take hold in Florida.

Biden is blundering our country towards the abyss and make no mistake: They’re coming for Florida because Florida represents a roadblock for the Biden agenda.

As long as I am Governor, Florida will continue to be that beachhead of freedom for the rest of the nation, and world, to follow.

I need your support to continue this uphill battle for the future of our state.

Can I count on you to stand with me on the side of freedom and secure the free future of Florida?

| VA Delegate John McGuire
I'm running for State Senate in 2023 so we can "Un-California" Virginia.
Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner)
---
| Dear Friend,
Summer is here and we are finally done with the 2022 budget, special session, and Congressional primaries. We are starting to prepare legislation for the 2023 session that begins January 11. I would like to hear your ideas. Just like this year, most of our good conservative bills will die in the Democrat controlled Senate next year, but we must continue to fight for life, the 2nd Amendment, and more.

Christian Conservative (Father - Navy SEAL - Business Owner) | Dear Friend, Summer is here and we are finally done with the 2022 budget, special session, and Congressional primaries. We are starting to prepare legislation for the 2023 session that begins January 11. I would like to hear your ideas. Just like this year, most of our good conservative bills will die in the Democrat controlled Senate next year, but we must continue to fight for life, the 2nd Amendment, and more. That is why it is also time for me to begin focusing more on my 2023 race to be your State Senator in District 10 so we can help Governor Youngkin pass his agenda, and undo the damage Democrats have done to our state. After five years in the House of Delegates, we've solved a zillion issues and made many friends. I've learned a lot, and I'm super fired up and ready to continue the fight for you in the Senate! We are all Americans and we should work together to improve our country. But so called leftist leaders are destroying everything that makes America great. Due to failed Democrat leadership, the world is less safe at the federal, state, and local level. Despite all the craziness going on in our country and around the world, keep working hard and keep the faith. God will determine the outcome! Here are some of the things on my mind, and what I've been up to around the district: | Let's "Un-California" Virginia | | Thank God we have a Republican Governor in Virginia, but the Democrat Senate is blocking or watering down just about everything we are trying to do. Most recently, you remember the Democrat Senate blocked several attempts to give you a gas tax holiday, which would have really helped our farmers. Over the last two years under Democrat rule in Virginia, they tried to "out-California" California here in Virginia, and there are several articles calling Virginia the "East Coast California". Make sure you and your friends vote this November so we can change that narrative. In January, 4000 plus criminals were released onto our streets, and our police were defunded and demeaned because Democrats believe criminals are good, police are bad, and no-one cares about the victims. Can you believe that UVA, a state funded school, is trying to cancel Thomas Jefferson? I'm running for state Senate in 2023 so that we can stop the "wokeness" and "un-California" Virginia. It starts with election integrity. | 2000 Mules Buckingham County | | We will show the movie, "2000 Mules", in Buckingham County on Thursday, July 21, at 5pm, at the Agricultural Center, 13380 West James Anderson Highway, Buckingham, VA 23921. They changed election laws/rules to make our elections less safe/ secure in the middle of the 2020 election under the excuse of COVID. Richmond City Mayor, Lavar Stoney, defunded, demeaned, and told our police to stand down during the riots. Now murder and crime, in general, is up in the city. What did they think would happen? Should we defund universities like UVA and William and Mary, who promote woke ideologies and want to cancel Thomas Jefferson? They put a transgender man into a women's prison and now two female prisoners are pregnant because of him. Are we living in "Nightmare-ica"? What did they think would happen? | Pray for Our Local Farmers | | These are tough times, especially for smaller farms. I've been meeting with many types of farmers around the district in order to listen to and learn from them. In addition to supply chain issues and rising fuel prices, lime and fertilizer prices are three times higher. On top of all of this, the average age of a farmer is 60. They predict the world population will double by 2050. Why do you think Bill Gates just bought 2100 acres of farmland in North Dakota, adding to the 270,000 acres he already owns throughout the US? | 4th of July | | On a positive note, together we can turn things around. Leon Benjamin for Congress fired us up with prayer. The place was packed with patriots, from all over Virginia, who love our country. Our country was founded in the Church. The Church is where we will save our country! | Louisa Fireman's Parade == | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | We had so much fun at the Mineral Fireman's Parade. We were proud to win a 2nd place float trophy in the parade; it must have been the President Trump flags! | Goochland Fireworks | | We had a great time watching the fireworks and celebrating our Independence in Goochland County! | Pro-Life Mission BBQ Dinner at the Family Foundation | | It was an honor to break bread with folks at our Pro-Life Mission BBQ Dinner at the Family Foundation. Senator Amanda Chase and I spoke on the importance of electing candidates with a pro-life voting record. Life is a miracle and it must be protected. I really appreciate Students for Life helping with phone banking. | McGuire Pro-Life Speech in 2020 | == | God knows who you are before your first heart beat. == to see Delegate John McGuire's impromptu speech on the floor of the General Assembly, about how life begins at conception. This speech was given when the Democrats tried to "out California" California and controlled all three statewide offices, the House of Delegates, and the State Senate. | Trump was Right | | == to watch a video with many things Trump was right about. | Jerone Davison for Congress 2A Video | == | Why we need the 2nd Amendment: "Democrats like to say we do not need an AR-15 for self-defense..." the video. The corrupt media does not mention that he is a "black" man talking about the need for 30 round magazines to protect his family from Democrat Klansmen wearing white hoods when they talk about this video. | Senator Amanda Chase Endorsement | | I am proud to have the endorsement of Senator Amanda Chase, for Virginia State Senate District 10. Amanda is running for re-election in Senate District 12\. Please support her ==. | Goochland Sheriff Agnew | | | At his home, I presented this resolution thanking former Goochland Sheriff Jim Agnew for 28 years of service to Goochland County. Without our men and women in law enforcement, we would not have a country. Thank you! | 605 Villiage Mobile Home Park | | | | | | | I stopped by 605 Village Mobile Home Park, where food was being distributed as part of the Federal National School Lunch Program, under USDA. The food is distributed through food banks in Louisa County, Monday through Thursday, to eight locations. I've knocked on every door in this community over the years, and I am happy to see Louisa County Public Schools, the Local Food Hub, and others helping these folks out. Thank you, Randy Herman, for sharing information with me, about what you guys do to help our community. | 2000 Mules Showing in Louisa | | | | | | We had a good turnout at our Louisa County "2000 Mules" showing. We must educate our community in order to prevent what happened in 2020 from happening again. Get involved by becoming an election officer or a pole watcher. | Moving Day Video | == | == of my office over the last five years in the Pocahontas Building,where we worked on legislation and provided constituent services. My amazing wife, Tracy, said one photo on the wall was not enough, so she put up many items to tell my story. We are now packed up and moving to the new General Assembly building on Broad Street. | 2000 Mules Showing in Hanover | | We had a good turnout at our Hanover County "2000 Mules" showing. It is important to educate our community in order to prevent what happened in 2020 from happening again. Get involved by becoming an election officer or a pole watcher. | Louisa Agricultural Fair | | | | Did you see our trailer at the Louisa County Agricultural Fair with our Trump flags? | Henrico GOP Breakfast | | I started Saturday morning with my "Wingman", Delegate Buddy Fowler of Hanover, and a huge crowd at the Henrico GOP Breakfast. Republicans are fired up and ready to take back the House in November! | Hanover Tomato Festival | | I ran into my friend Delegate Scott Wyatt of Hanover, Hanover Fire Chief Jethro Piland, and others at the Hanover Tomato Festival. Everyone loves Hanover Tomatoes! | Appomattox County | | | | | I had a lot of fun meeting folks and making new friends in Appomattox County this weekend. I hope you like this video! == | Louisa County Agricultural Fair Livestock Auction | | I'm proud to support the Louisa County Agricultural Fair Livestock Auction again this year. Thanks for all you do to support, educate, and inspire our future farmers! | Amelia County | | | | | Thank you, Amelia Dixie, Youth Major All-stars, and coaches for doing a great job cleaning my Ford Raptor. They are raising money for their trip to Anderson, South Carolina, for the Division II Major League World Series at the end of this month. Please consider helping them raise needed funds. == | Making Friends | | | | | Senate District 10 is home to some amazing people. If you see me on the side of the road give a beep or stop by and say hello and get a yard sign. I look forward to seeing you soon! | 274 Churches | | I'm far from perfect, but I work hard, I love our country, and I put God first. Our country was founded in the Church. During my time serving our country as a Navy SEAL, I attended church in every country or place I visited. Since the day I began my journey in politics in 2017, I decided to do the same thing. I have now attended 274 different places of worship in the district. Tracy and I attend our own church at 8am each Sunday, and then I attend a second or third church around the district. Sometimes Tracy joins me to worship at other churches. I hope to join you at your church soon! | | | | Our communities are less safe due to Democrat policies. I'm running for state Senate in 2023 so that we can stop the "wokeness" and "un-California" Virginia. It starts with election integrity. I invite you and your friends to join me in this cause. # Dear Peter,

The Maryland Primary Election is **TODAY!** Polls are open from 7:00 AM - 8:00 PM, and _I am asking for your vote.__ _

I am running for governor to stand up for every hardworking Marylander who is struggling to make ends meet.

I am running to represent every parent who demands their child get a world-class education to create a brighter future for their children.

I am fighting for the safety of our communities and the integrity of the officers that protect our families.

And I am fighting to create opportunity in our great state and to make Maryland more affordable so that you can raise a family, start a business, and retire right here in Maryland.

**I am fighting for YOU. **

Serving as your governor will be the greatest honor of my life.

_**I am humbly asking for your vote today.**_

Together we can and will make history!

Thank you,
---
|
---
| **Kelly Schulz**
Candidate for Governor

Friend, Our first campaign of the 2022 cycle targeting conspiracy theorist Doug Mastriano continues to gain steam in Pennsylvania. Our research shows that thousands more Republicans in the state have their own misgivings, but might think that they have no other option but to vote for him. Ahead of the election, it’s critical to let those Republicans know they’re not alone and that their misgivings are valid. We run all of our testimonials through rigorous testing and found that Patrick’s story was most effective at convincing voters that we must defeat Mastriano in November. | | **Peter Lumaj Issues Statement on Leora Levy's Campaign's Recent Attacks**
---
| Following an email sent out by the Levy Campaign yesterday, Peter Lumaj made the following statement:

"The voters in Connecticut have an important choice to make on August 9th, and I certainly encourage a spirited debate throughout this primary. What strikes me as morally reprehensible was Leora Levy's decision to launch a massive personal attack against Themis Klarides while her family is grieving the passing of her mother. In campaigns we have to talk about candidates' records and any issues in them must be discussed and brought before the voters. But for now I am calling on Leora Levy to leave personal attacks against Themis Klarides out of the discussion for the next few days, to give her and her family time to mourn. I will be praying for Themis and her family over the next few days, and I encourage you to as well."

He is one of the smartest, most effective, and hardest working public servants. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zJ7b5wNyzKPLhTo-AgqfOTj9hmS-8LvnA8qY7ch-DzuoBS8d9D5n0LCvYKNPlHQRhV6DqzUgt1idmRGmMLH_00cTIy3Gk6_jQpJq4eAQYgHzwvSQShhUDxcF1EhjecjbVx08oLrfnbFvVILr9NV7iIUfd3BO270DhbpGRH-UNAMopX4nzAeLcRpHTEsUVEKUvcplEaybT3mw-GD2kCv_-CiujdmbynEiOVRA5vl8OEx99PYtXXL7GxUOwZmraJbtiV9_pr5ZDTroT9NaI8W5lK8qOY_lWc6tVLfgBi4pralg/3nv/tAQg2b73QC6W2z9BMpAsyQ/h0/1cKpNEvfRx1_L52Ju7l4NoRU0kPjJwFz5_CChNjzZIQ)

Dear friend, I am sure you know we have a very important primary election today and I hope I have earned your vote, but I am writing to you about someone else who is on the ballot: Congressman Jamie Raskin. I have known Jamie for decades. He served as my campaign chair for both of my State’s Attorney races and I was “in the room where it happened” urging Jamie to enter politics and run for the state senate. Since then, over my sixteen years in elected office, we have worked together on important issues for Maryland, including marriage equality, voting rights, civil rights, and criminal justice. I always have known that **Jamie Raskin is one of the smartest, most effective, and hardest working public servants** , but his latest work protecting our Democracy has shown people around the country what we know here already: **Jamie Raskin is brilliant and he is fearless.** That is why he was named the**lead impeachment manager** in Donald Trump’s second impeachment and it is why he is **one of only seven Democrats** on the committee investigating what happened to the U.S. Capitol on January 6. And that is why we need him now. Make no mistake we are facing serious challenges. An activist Supreme Court that already has overturned Roe v Wade and turned back the few gun safety measures we had on the books in states like Maryland. A rise in violent far-right extremism that threatens our very Democracy. **Inflation, exploding crime, inaction on climate change, and threats to basic civil rights that we all thought were settled.** In fact, just a few days ago, one of the federal judges pushed through by Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell **blocked efforts to protect LGBTQ people in the workplace.** **We are going backwards.** These times call for serious people who can help us find the way forward. **There is simply no one I would rather have leading that charge in Congress than Jamie Raskin.** He understands the complexities we face and he also understands how to communicate those complexities and make winning arguments. I am not particularly worried about Jamie in the primary today, but **I have learned not to take anything for granted in politics, so I hope you will all support Jamie Raskin**. He has earned our support many many times over. Thank you, Doug

That is why he was named thelead impeachment manager in Donald Trump’s second impeachment and it is why he is one of only seven Democrats on the committee investigating what happened to the U.S. Capitol on January 6. And that is why we need him now. Make no mistake we are facing serious challenges. An activist Supreme Court that already has overturned Roe v Wade and turned back the few gun safety measures we had on the books in states like Maryland. A rise in violent far-right extremism that threatens our very Democracy. Inflation, exploding crime, inaction on climate change, and threats to basic civil rights that we all thought were settled. In fact, just a few days ago, one of the federal judges pushed through by Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell blocked efforts to protect LGBTQ people in the workplace. We are going backwards. These times call for serious people who can help us find the way forward. There is simply no one I would rather have leading that charge in Congress than Jamie Raskin. He understands the complexities we face and he also understands how to communicate those complexities and make winning arguments. I am not particularly worried about Jamie in the primary today, but I have learned not to take anything for granted in politics, so I hope you will all support Jamie Raskin. He has earned our support many many times over. Thank you, Doug | By Authority: Friends of Doug Gansler, Terry Denney, Treasurer; Ana Sol Gutierrez, Chair. Friends of Doug Gansler P.O.
