name: Eric Greitens
subject: A Personal Reflection— Why I Want to Serve Missouri
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greitens for U
body:
I'd be honored to receive your vote on August 2nd to serve as your U.S. Senator.
---
| | | | | |
---
| A Personal Reflection from Governor Eric Greitens-- Why I Want to Serve Missouri
---
| Hey there,
It's clearer now than ever that we need people who are willing to buck the establishment handlers, the political insiders, and the lobbyist class to fight for real people. I've stood up for what's I believe is right my entire life.
I learned the hard lesson in 2018 that taking a stand against the political uniparty Swamp comes at a cost--vicious lies, constant unfair attacks on my family and the people I work with, and even fake criminal charges from a Soros-funded prosecutor.
But I honestly believe that God sometimes gives us pain and on the other side there is wisdom. Sometimes God gives us unwanted suffering and on the other side there is strength. I've seen the face of the enemy we are facing in America today. I feel stronger, wiser, and more courageous than ever before in my life. As we near the August 2nd primary election, I took some time to reflect on the incredible successes we accomplished together, when I was your governor. Our team accomplished more than anyone ever thought possible. Here's just some of what this team accomplished:
- We fought for jobs. We grew 38,400 new jobs from January 2017 through April 2018. That is the highest rate of job growth in modern Missouri history. We jumped 9 places in the rankings for best states to do business, and we now have the lowest unemployment rate in 18 years.
We passed a bill to make Missouri compete for steel mills and other advanced manufacturing, to bring quality jobs back to our workers. Those jobs are now coming, hundreds of workers have already started, a steel mill and aluminum smelter are open, and hundreds more jobs are on the way.
---
|
---
| - We cut burdensome regulations and got the government off people's backs. We signed a law allowing Uber, Lyft, and other ride-sharing apps to create more jobs in Missouri.
We did a complete review of every red-tape regulation on the books, and we identified 33,000 regulatory restrictions to be wiped out--one out of every three. We made it simpler for people to get the licenses they need to find work.
- We fought for ethics. We banned lobbyist gifts for executive branch personnel. We slammed shut the revolving door between executive branch employees and lobbyists.
We took on insiders and rip-off artists to cut spending on Missouri's biggest, most corrupt tax credit from $1.3 billion over the last decade to $0.00.
- We got better results with less taxpayer money, and cut taxes. We cut over $700 million in spending in our first six months in office to balance the state budget without raising taxes.
We cut Missouri's tax rate for businesses from 6.25% to 4.0%, while simplifying the tax code and eliminating special rules that benefited companies that only invested and hired workers outside of Missouri.
We got rid of cars, planes, and any government vehicles Missouri didn't need to save taxpayer dollars. We reformed our state workforce to make it easier to hire good people, reward the best performance, and shrink government. We eliminated and merged dozens of boards and commissions, to get rid of 138 politically appointed positions.
---
|
---
| \- We stood up for law enforcement officers and first responders. We passed tougher penalties for attacks on police officers and first responders. We protected everyone's constitutional rights, while ensuring safety during civil unrest in St. Louis, and had the backs of our law enforcement officers. Major threats of violence ended after 48 hours.
We established a Blue Alert system to make sure the public is aware when an attack on an officer occurs, so that the cowards who would attack police can be brought to justice quickly.
We let first responders and police officers know that, no matter what some people might throw their way, the people of Missouri respect and love them.
---
|
---
| \- We fought for our principles. We called a special session to pass the strongest pro-life bill in Missouri in a generation, which has stood up to challenges from the ACLU, Planned Parenthood, and the Satanic Temple.
We appointed strong, conservative judges to positions around the state--including Missouri's Supreme Court.
We stood up for people of faith ended the state's policy of discriminating against religious groups purely because of their religious identity.
---
|
---
| \- We kept people safe. We launched a comprehensive statewide response to the opioid epidemic, including establishing a prescription drug monitoring program, cracking down on chronic over-prescribers, increasing the availability of lifesaving medications, and improving training for providers.
We cracked down on the trafficking of heroin and other drugs on state highways, with a new cross-departmental enforcement initiative.
We launched a major initiative to bring state assets including the Highway Patrol to bear against the crime problem in St. Louis.
We overhauled the state's emergency response philosophy, adopting a "go early, go big" approach that has consistently minimized damage and lives lost. Through tornados, floods, and ice storms we were able to keep families out of harm's way and get assistance to communities quickly.
---
|
---
| \- We passed reforms that conservatives have fought for, for generations.
We signed a comprehensive public sector union reform package, including paycheck protection, more financial record transparency, and re-certification elections.
We passed a ban on Project Labor Agreements to protect taxpayer dollars and to ensure that all workers and contractors can fairly bid on public construction projects.
Missouri was the 49th worst state in the country for frivolous lawsuits. We protected small businesses from trial lawyers that threaten jobs, by pushing for more tort reform than any state in the country.
---
|
---
| \- We stood up for Missouri's kids, the children in our foster care system. We launched a comprehensive review of Missouri's foster and adoptive care system.

---

---
|

# From the Desk of Dominic Rapini
|
---
**Dominic Rapini Calls Out SOTS for Amateurish Handling of Republican Primary Ballots**
[](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=0187030530&e=8763c56857)
**BRANFORD, Conn—** Dominic Rapini – the Republican endorsed candidate for Secretary of the State – called out the Secretary of the State’s office on Monday for the amateur move in the handling of primary ballots in light of the withdrawal of fellow Republican Secretary of the State candidate, Brock Weber.“When a horse scratches at the track, they use a marker to remove his name from the sheet. But elections aren’t horse races—a sharpie is not the solution,” Dominic Rapini said.Last week, Weber, announced his withdrawal from the three-way Republican Secretary of the State race. Shortly after, the Secretary of the State’s office sent an email to registrars giving them three options on how they address removing Weber’s name from the already printed ballots: using a sharpie marker to blot out his name, using a sticker to remove his name and hand counting the ballots, or reprinting and reprograming the memory cards.“If I was Secretary of the State when this happened, I would have had a contingency plan in place to reprint the ballots when Weber initially withdrew last week," said Rapini. “The Secretary of the State’s office chooses instead a lack of uniformity amongst our towns and municipalities that will create mass confusion and further diminish the integrity of our election process.”“I don’t believe a ballot should be altered after being printed. I would also like to know where the other SOTS candidates stand on this and why they are being silent? Is it because they don’t have any solutions or is it because they are content with the status quo?”Rapini concluded, “Simply stated, this is yet another example of incompetence and failure from Hartford.”
|

clean_body: Dominic says instructions regarding primary ballots are "amateur." | | | From the Desk of Dominic Rapini | Dominic Rapini Calls Out SOTS for Amateurish Handling of Republican Primary Ballots BRANFORD, Conn— Dominic Rapini – the Republican endorsed candidate for Secretary of the State – called out the Secretary of the State’s office on Monday for the amateur move in the handling of primary ballots in light of the withdrawal of fellow Republican Secretary of the State candidate, Brock Weber.“When a horse scratches at the track, they use a marker to remove his name from the sheet. But elections aren’t horse races—a sharpie is not the solution,” Dominic Rapini said.Last week, Weber, announced his withdrawal from the three-way Republican Secretary of the State race. Shortly after, the Secretary of the State’s office sent an email to registrars giving them three options on how they address removing Weber’s name from the already printed ballots: using a sharpie marker to blot out his name, using a sticker to remove his name and hand counting the ballots, or reprinting and reprograming the memory cards.“If I was Secretary of the State when this happened, I would have had a contingency plan in place to reprint the ballots when Weber initially withdrew last week," said Rapini. “The Secretary of the State’s office chooses instead a lack of uniformity amongst our towns and municipalities that will create mass confusion and further diminish the integrity of our election process.”“I don’t believe a ballot should be altered after being printed. I would also like to know where the other SOTS candidates stand on this and why they are being silent? Is it because they don’t have any solutions or is it because they are content with the status quo?”Rapini concluded, “Simply stated, this is yet another example of incompetence and failure from Hartford.” | Volunteer with Team Dominic! Hello,

I've worn many different hats over the years. Horseback rider. Mom. Advocate. State Senator. U.S. Senator.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48028633/356636425/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1315-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDc5MmMyYS03NDA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DsAVz5_OzHW2IDDIfsSizPOtTpbslDddJeAewdoFjJQ=)
It's that last one I'm emailing about.

I'm one of 50 Democrats serving in the U.S. Senate. We have a narrow majority because the Vice President serves as a tiebreaker. I won my last race by just 1,017 votes. * * *

Dan knows how tough it is for working families and is committed to lowering costs for people every day. From gas and groceries to prescription drugs, he is standing up to price gouging companies to ensure that hardworking people don’t get the short end of the stick. And he’s worked with Republicans and Democrats alike to support fair trade deals that bring back Michigan manufacturing.

For Dan, elected office is not about scoring political points or getting likes on social media. It’s about making sure that working families can put food on the table, pay rent or mortgage, and support their families.

**Dan is in office to improve the lives of mid-Michiganders, not play party politics.**

From introducing legislation to bringing chip manufacturing back to the United States — which will lower costs and bring good-paying, union jobs back home — to supporting measures to suspend the gas tax for the rest of the year so we can put money back into the hands of the American people, Dan has a plan to make life more affordable for working families and is delivering on that plan every day.

This is the leadership that Dan brings to Congress. His commonsense, pro-worker approach means that he is focused on delivering for working families, manufacturers, farmers, and all those who keep our country moving forward.

And we want to know if you support the work that Dan is doing to make life more affordable for working families. There is still more to be done, but we want to hear from you about the steps that Dan is already taking to lower costs.

Derek, They say that the third time’s the charm, but it appears the Governor may have missed the memo. After two years of being named the #1 state for business, Glenn Youngkin ran a campaign on the idea that the Virginia economy was in the ditch. Six months into his term, we’ve dropped to 3rd. That begs the question: _if #1 was "in the ditch," where are we now, Governor?_ Glenn Youngkin’s campaign for Governor was spent claiming that he’d run Virginia like a business. Yet, predictably, his bigoted and unwelcoming “culture war” policies have pushed away businesses, dragging the Commonwealth down from our former distinction as the best state in the Union for business. Welcoming Democratic policies built economic prosperity here in Virginia. It’s a shame that Glenn Youngkin’s incompetency has dragged our state down from our top spot on the national stage. What makes it even worse is that he doesn’t seem to be focused on working on returning Virginia to that top spot. clean_body: Youngkin loses VA’s distinction as business superpower | Derek, They say that the third time’s the charm, but it appears the Governor may have missed the memo. After two years of being named the #1 state for business, Glenn Youngkin ran a campaign on the idea that the Virginia economy was in the ditch. Six months into his term, we’ve dropped to 3rd. That begs the question: if #1 was "in the ditch," where are we now, Governor? Glenn Youngkin’s campaign for Governor was spent claiming that he’d run Virginia like a business. Yet, predictably, his bigoted and unwelcoming “culture war” policies have pushed away businesses, dragging the Commonwealth down from our former distinction as the best state in the Union for business. Welcoming Democratic policies built economic prosperity here in Virginia. It’s a shame that Glenn Youngkin’s incompetency has dragged our state down from our top spot on the national stage. What makes it even worse is that he doesn’t seem to be focused on working on returning Virginia to that top spot. Instead, he’s left our Commonwealth to go plan his campaign for president in 2024. If we want to be recognized once again as the top state for business, it’s clear that we’re going to have to work to elect Democrats across the Commonwealth. | | I really want you to be part of my grassroots team trying to make the world a better place. So I want to share a little about what drives me and then **I want to ask what drives you?** To me, America has always been about giving underdogs a chance. My grandmother lived for a time in a boxcar. My dad overcame a debilitating illness as a teenager that left him hospitalized for a year – and yet he lived a full life as a husband, a father, and a union machinist. My dad earned enough that my parents could join the middle class, buy a modest ranch home, take camping vacations, and save for retirement. And thanks to my parents and my public school teachers, I became the first in my family to go to college. **My family's story is the story of America creating opportunity.** And I've spent my adult life fighting for people who need a chance. Before I was in the Senate, I led nonprofits that created affordable housing. As a state legislator, I threw the payday lenders out of Oregon. In the Senate, I fought to put predatory mortgage lenders out of business across America and shut down the Wall Street casino that crashed the economy. I've passed bills for LGBTQ equality. And I even had the police called on me when I tried to visit and investigate Donald Trump's border prison for migrant children. **My family still lives in the same blue collar neighborhood that I grew up in** , but today, hope and opportunity feel a lot further away for our neighbors than it did when I was growing up. Their chances are different not because their families are different, but because America is different. We've got a LOT to do to get America back on track and ensure all Americans have every opportunity to succeed. Job #1, of course, is getting this pandemic under control and the economic crisis that has followed. clean_body: | | | | I really want you to be part of my grassroots team trying to make the world a better place. So I want to share a little about what drives me and then I want to ask what drives you? To me, America has always been about giving underdogs a chance. My grandmother lived for a time in a boxcar. My dad overcame a debilitating illness as a teenager that left him hospitalized for a year – and yet he lived a full life as a husband, a father, and a union machinist. My dad earned enough that my parents could join the middle class, buy a modest ranch home, take camping vacations, and save for retirement. And thanks to my parents and my public school teachers, I became the first in my family to go to college. My family's story is the story of America creating opportunity. And I've spent my adult life fighting for people who need a chance. Before I was in the Senate, I led nonprofits that created affordable housing. As a state legislator, I threw the payday lenders out of Oregon. In the Senate, I fought to put predatory mortgage lenders out of business across America and shut down the Wall Street casino that crashed the economy. I've passed bills for LGBTQ equality. And I even had the police called on me when I tried to visit and investigate Donald Trump's border prison for migrant children. My family still lives in the same blue collar neighborhood that I grew up in , but today, hope and opportunity feel a lot further away for our neighbors than it did when I was growing up. Their chances are different not because their families are different, but because America is different. We've got a LOT to do to get America back on track and ensure all Americans have every opportunity to succeed. Job #1, of course, is getting this pandemic under control and the economic crisis that has followed. But even before the pandemic, we faced many tough challenges. Here's my question for you: Other than ending the pandemic, what's your highest priority right now? = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = If you've got more ideas and opinions to share with me, please don't hesitate to click REPLY and write me back. body:
Insurrectionists want to run state elections
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, your vote only counts if your Secretary of State’s office counts it before certifying the results. We can do all the work we want getting out the vote for good candidates, but it might not count if election officials are corrupt. Which is why it’s important to remember that ... **Insurrectionists are still agitating to steal or overturn our elections. Some insurrectionists are campaigning to be Secretaries of State.**
## **The Secretaries of State elected this year will be the people deciding who wins the presidency in 2024.**
## **[Will you join me in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the Democratic Association of Secretaries of State, so we can ensure that in 2024 we have someone setting up the electoral process and counting votes in each key state who believes in democracy?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T45d84c43-1c93-4058-bda9-9fb23fb9708e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
During the shocking Jan. 6th hearings, we found that Donald Trump, Mark Meadows, Ted Cruz, Josh Hawley and dozens of House members, state legislators, governors and other officials **told the deadly lie ****that Donald Trump won the election enough times that it inspired people to commit acts of vandalism, violence and treason.** Two of these individuals, de-programmed, as if from a cult, talked about why they attacked the Capitol on January 6th, 2020, why they were there, what they believed, and what they intended to do. And it all came down to one very simple fact: If they had not been lied to by Republicans day in and day out--the very Republicans who are still inciting riot every day by lying about this election--then January 6th would not have happened. A dozen or so House members were revealed to have met with Donald Trump to plan the coup, likely leading to criminal liability for them. Yet, some of them and various other **_GOP officials are now running for positions where they will have control of state election machinery. _**For example, one of these coup plotters, Jody Hice of Georgia, was running for Secretary of State (SoS) in a primary vs Republican Brad Raffensberger, who stood up to Trump's calls for stealing votes.

Here in Wisconsin, our beautiful state is already feeling the effects of decades of inaction on the climate crisis.

Wisconsin’s average temperatures are about two degrees Fahrenheit warmer than in the 1950s, and they’re expected to go up. We’re experiencing more snowfall, even though our winter seasons are shorter. Extreme rains are becoming more common, and the interim dry spells will be disastrous for our farming communities.

Climate change is speeding up, but elected leaders have failed to act to protect our state and our planet. My career in the military and CIA gave me the opportunity to see much of this beautiful world, and **I deeply believe that we have a duty to secure its future for the children of our nation and that of every nation.

NPR: “Supreme Court restricts the EPA's authority to mandate carbon emissions reductions” This is unacceptable.= Here in Wisconsin, our beautiful state is already feeling the effects of decades of inaction on the climate crisis. Wisconsin’s average temperatures are about two degrees Fahrenheit warmer than in the 1950s, and they’re expected to go up. We’re experiencing more snowfall, even though our winter seasons are shorter. Extreme rains are becoming more common, and the interim dry spells will be disastrous for our farming communities. Climate change is speeding up, but elected leaders have failed to act to protect our state and our planet. Peter,

On January 6, 2021, we watched as an armed mob – incited by Donald Trump – vandalized our Capitol, attacked police officers, and tried to overturn the results of a free and fair election. Following the attack on our Capitol, the House put together a committee to investigate the attack.

Already, so much has been revealed – including Republican members of Congress requesting pardons for their involvement and Trump's knowledge that his claims of voter fraud were baseless.

**We know this only scratches the surface – but if Republicans retake the House in November, there will be no accountability at all.** As Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy said he would shut down the committee on day one. And Jim Jordan, the leading Republican on the House Judiciary Committee, said impeaching Attorney General Merrick Garland is on the table.

The future of our democracy is on the line this November. We can't afford to have Allan Fung and Trumpist Republicans retake the House and shut down this critical investigation. But now, we want to hear from you:

Already, people are being forced to travel out of state to access needed medical care. And as always, Mike DeWine responds with empty platitudes and refuses to acknowledge that he caused this by signing Ohio’s draconian anti-abortion bill into law. While abortion has become much more inaccessible to many without _Roe_ , it’s far from the first time Governor DeWine has pushed to restrict abortion – of the many attacks he has launched on reproductive rights during his time in office, here are just a few:
* In the days before the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , giving free reign to state Republicans to restrict reproductive rights, he said he wanted to “go as far as we can” to ban abortion.
* He signed into law a bill banning abortion after just six weeks – before many people even know they’re pregnant – with no exceptions even for rape or incest.
* He fought to defund Planned Parenthood and force clinic closures in Ohio.
* As Attorney General, he wrote a brief in defense of Hobby Lobby’s denial of contraception coverage.
* He pushed the Ohio Supreme Court to overturn a lower court ruling that kept Toledo’s last abortion clinic open.

**Here in Ohio we believe that reproductive decisions should be made by people, not politicians or corporations – and we deserve a governor who will fight for that right.**

body:

This past weekend, Lizzie joined Texas Democrats at the State Party Convention in Dallas.
Lizzie at the Texas Democrats at the State Party Convention in Dallas. [https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/763831633863576E352B7437717062596E69766B7873393256794143302F51526B50516C3378576748797446565736704C4872454F4D6E4446332B4462685141/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202022-07-19%20at%2012.19.29%20PM.png]
There are critical elections happening across our state this year — including ours in TX-07. The convention underscored the urgency of electing leaders like Lizzie who fight for true Texas priorities, like access to health care, common sense gun-safety measures, and our rights and equality as Texans. And it also reminded us how important it is to have people on the ground getting others to the polls.
You play a vital role in making that happen. #TeamLizzie is working together to re-elect Lizzie so she can keep fighting for us in Congress, and we’re so grateful for your support and all you do for our campaign.
The Texas Farm Bureau AGFUND endorsed Lizzie for re-election!
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/476625/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/476625/]
Texas is number one in the country for total number of farms. Our agriculture industry plays a critical role in our nation’s economy, contributing billions of dollars each year.
Lizzie listens to the concerns of Texas’ farmers and ranchers and stands up for them in Congress to make sure they have the resources they need to thrive, drive our economy, and ensure Texas families have food on the table.
These endorsements provide essential momentum for our campaign, and with 16 weeks to go until Election Day, we’re thrilled to have the support of organizations like the Texas Farm Bureau AGFUND.
The Washington Post :
“Lawmakers push Biden to declare public health emergency on abortion”
July 12, 2022
In case you missed it: Earlier this month, President Biden took an important step by signing an executive order protecting access to abortion medication and emergency contraception. Lizzie led a group of more than 80 members of Congress urging President Biden to take the additional step of declaring the end of Roe v. Wade and nationwide abortion rights a public health emergency.
Because, let’s be clear, this is an emergency. The Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe has created and will continue to create a health crisis for millions. Experts say it will cause the U.S. maternal mortality rate to rise — a rate that is already the highest of any developed country.
“The president’s executive order was a good place to start,
but not a good place to stop. To respond effectively, we need to use every tool available to protect patients and health care providers.”
- Rep. Lizzie Fletcher

We still have one more favor to ask — can you forward this email to three friends to make sure they’ve gone out to cast their ballot for John and Michelle? **If no:** What are you waiting for? This moment could not be more urgent. John and Michelle are the only gubernatorial ticket with the vision and experience to make real change — so we’re asking you to step up and head to the polls. We can usher Maryland into a new era of progressive leadership, but only if we seize these next six hours and make sure all of our friends, family members, neighbors, coworkers, classmates, barbers, dog park pals, local baristas, or even folks you pass by on the street get out there and vote. | | | | Dear Fellow Conservative, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](http://trk.readactnews.) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.

* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents andthe community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" -- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](http://trk.readactnews.) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](http://trk.readactnews.-4ANoBneghA) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

Peter, I returned from my last combat deployment in Afghanistan in January 2021.

When I came home, I thought I could sleep at night knowing that America would always be in good hands.

_But just six months later, I watched Joe Biden abandon our troops in Afghanistan and let terrorists take over Kabul._

It reminded me of what happen when my family watched Saigon fall in 1975, and I knew the chaos that would come for everyone who was left behind.

**In that moment, I knew I couldn’t sit back and relax. If we were going to preserve our status as the greatest country in the world, I had to act.**

**I’m running for Congress because we can’t trust Joe Biden to lead America to continued greatness. And with weakness in the White House, it’s up to Republicans in Congress to pick up where Democrats are abandoning us.**

clean_body: | | | Peter, I returned from my last combat deployment in Afghanistan in January 2021. When I came home, I thought I could sleep at night knowing that America would always be in good hands. But just six months later, I watched Joe Biden abandon our troops in Afghanistan and let terrorists take over Kabul. It reminded me of what happen when my family watched Saigon fall in 1975, and I knew the chaos that would come for everyone who was left behind. In that moment, I knew I couldn’t sit back and relax. If we were going to preserve our status as the greatest country in the world, I had to act. I’m running for Congress because we can’t trust Joe Biden to lead America to continued greatness. And with weakness in the White House, it’s up to Republicans in Congress to pick up where Democrats are abandoning us. If we keep letting Joe Biden and the socialist Democrats fail us, our country will fall behind - and who knows if we’ll ever get back to where we were. We have a chance to save America before it’s too late, but I need you to act. Just like during my time in the Navy, I can’t finish this mission alone. America is counting on us, Peter. Andy has been a passionate and committed leader in the House, Peter.
I’m proud to have stood side-by-side with him to fight for the rights of women, legislate for housing justice, stand up for workers, and advocate on behalf of our Haitian neighbors as co-chairs of the House Haiti Caucus.
As one of the original cosponsors of the Green New Deal, Andy has delivered millions of dollars to Michigan in Green New Deal funding, and he’s led calls to shut down the aging Line 5 oil pipeline that carries millions of gallons of crude oil per day through the state.
Andy is also taking on the right-wing prosecutors and health systems trying to deny abortion care, and he supports reforming and expanding the Supreme Court so that these conservative, minority viewpoints can no longer be imposed against the will of the people.
**Most importantly, Andy’s service is defined by a fierce commitment to the people he represents in the current MI-9, and an indefatigable work ethic to strengthen and support our communities.**
Andy will win this election on the ground by connecting with voters, because connecting with voters is what he does best. I’m proud to call him a friend and partner, and I look forward to working together for years to come in Congress. Together, we can make sure that we have Andy’s voice in the House to fight to pass our progressive agenda.

| | | Peter,

The General Election is off to a GREAT start.
**The National Organization for Women Political Action Committee has endorsed our campaign!**
I want to make sure that every Eastern Montanan knows I'll fight to protect access to all healthcare, including reproductive care.

[__**Will you chip in $50 right now to help us get the word out?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=f293c1bfa1&e=2f4ec52c5e)
---
| | “With women’s basic rights and bodily autonomy under severe attack in the U.S., Montana NOW is proud that the National Organization for Women's Political Action Committee (NOW PAC) has enthusiastically ratified our State Chapter’s recommendation to endorse Penny Ronning for U.S. Congresswoman for Montana’s 2nd Congressional District.

Penny Ronning is a strong Women’s and Human Rights Champion—not only rhetorically, but through years-long activism—who has consistently stood for equity for all. Ronning has made it her mission to stand for those who are at risk: Sexually trafficked girls and women, Missing and Murdered Indigenous People, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, small business people, and Montana’s family farmers and ranchers. She has a record of working successfully across the political aisle, and she listens to the voices of her constituents,” **said Marilynn Miller, Treasurer of Montana Chapter of NOW.**
---
| As a nation, we've got to do a better job empowering our women and supporting our families. That's why I support common-sense measures like paid family leave, extending the child tax credit, and codifying the right to make private medical decisions.

Our right to privacy should not be infringed!

[__**Can I count on you chipping $50 today to help me fight to protect women's rights?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=876f320a84&e=2f4ec52c5e)

Thank you and together we rise!

The COVID mandates shut down businesses and crippled the financial sector of our country. Americans were robbed of their freedom._And all for what?_ Nothing more than political theater.

_**And which state was the worst one of all? That’s right, California, under Newsom’s chokehold.**_

[_**Donate today to recruit Ron DeSantis for President >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38179%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=go6EiBqionDo7d5dF93kbA&sysid=1)

While Newsom gave in to Biden’s demands, DeSantis fought back.

DeSantis fought to keep the economy open during COVID so small businesses could survive, and families could make ends meet.

He’s been unwaveringly committed to fighting for parental rights in education, has stopped Common Core, and got CRT out of classrooms.

Ron DeSantis fought for the rights of the people, and because of him, today, Florida is one of the most successful and freest states in the Union.

| Peter Willis,I wanted to give you a little update on the campaign, highlighting two interesting articles out this week.The Washington Examiner did [a great profile on our race](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62d6c2bc006676709316b562&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.washingtonexaminer.com%2Fnews%2Fcampaigns%2Ftom-barrett-michigan-democratic-rep-elissa-slotkin&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=6kJoCrZDEH_iokUC1TQemGLoxso%3D), highlighting criticism of my opponent, Elissa Slotkin, who talks like Joe Manchin but votes like Nancy Pelosi ([voted with Pelosi 98% of the time](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62d6c2bc006676709316b562&u=https%3A%2F%2Fprojects.propublica.org%2Frepresent%2Fmembers%2FP000197-nancy-pelosi%2Fcompare-votes%2FS001208-elissa-slotkin%2F117&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=AglzhxDbkPRGLRvJK_n4t4XSVdg%3D)).On Sunday, The Detroit News ran [my op/ed opposing corporate welfare](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62d6c2bc006676709316b562&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fopinion%2F2022%2F07%2F17%2Fbarett-corporate-incentives-dont-work%2F10061178002%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=HjuS8_JKSwEAqQ1KSbmigiKlrpU%3D). After one-such taxpayer giveaway, [my opponent exclaimed](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62d6c2bc006676709316b562&u=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2FpHy2Bqai3sY&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=0FHGEFQCUBhAHkQWo1BnPKHCXoM%3D) that giving “a s#!% ton of money” to corporations “is the way government is supposed to work.” I’ve voted no on these “incentives” 99% of the time over my seven years in public office and never regretted it. Last week, the Michigan Supreme Court forced the State to release secret Non-Disclosure-Agreements revealing $3.8 billion in taxpayer-funded subsidies to just one corporation. The 10,000 jobs they created cost taxpayers $340,000 each.The path to a Republican Majority runs through Michigan’s 7th District and I’m glad to have you on my team!

subject: Do you have a specific plan to Vote?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ben Smilowitz for Congress
body:
Ask your friends! Today's the day! | | | |
---
|
---
| | | **Dear Peter,** **Today is election day!** Everything we've been working towards for much of the last year. **So my only question is: Do you have a plan to vote?**

**The #1 way to ensure that you vote is to have a specific plan _*ahead of time*_ for when you're going to vote.** It doesn't matter when! _The most important thing is that you have a specific plan._

[**And if you're not sure where you can vote - look it up right here!**](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=8d7234c89a&e=0faa9de128)

**Ask your friends, too! If you have a friend that you aren't sure is going to vote, make a plan with them! Text or call them right now!**

As always, _thank you so much_ for everything you've done for this campaign. I've had such wonderful conversations with so many voters about their hopes and dreams and what keeps them up at night. So many people across our great district shared so much and I'm deeply grateful.

Maryland's Sixth Congressional District is remarkable. We live in a great place and yes - we do have plenty of challenges. Together we can make it better.

Thank you,
Ben

_(Margin of error +/- 3.87%, July 1 – 11, 2022)_

Yuh-Line Niou 16%
Carlina Rivera 16%
Daniel Goldman 10%
Mondaire Jones 8%
Jo Anne Simon 6%
Elizabeth Holtzman 4%
Bill de Blasio 3%

clean_body: We’ve seen what happens when this grassroots movement bands together. | | | Peter, these new poll results just came across our desk and we wanted to make sure you saw them: New York’s 10th Congressional District: Democratic Primary (Margin of error +/- 3.87%, July 1 – 11, 2022) Yuh-Line Niou 16% Carlina Rivera 16% Daniel Goldman 10% Mondaire Jones 8% Jo Anne Simon 6% Elizabeth Holtzman 4% Bill de Blasio 3% Maud Maron 2% Don’t know/undecided 40% When Yuh-Line Niou first announced her candidacy for this brand-new district in lower Manhattan and Brooklyn, some newspapers wouldn’t even print her name. But Yuh-Line’s record of political courage and bold leadership is resonating more and more with voters across the district every day. The polls and all the grassroots energy we are seeing across the district makes it clear: We have a real shot at sending another WFP champion to Congress, but only if Yuh-Line and our team have the resources we need to reach voters before her primary on August 23rd. Yuh-Line has been a WFP champion since 2016, when she won her underdog bid for the New York State Assembly. She’s worked alongside WFP to advance progressive priorities in the State Legislature, including taxing the rich, historic tenant protections, and relief for immigrant workers. And she’s shown us that she’s a true fighter for working families through her work to tackle corruption, take on the New York real estate lobby, organize for pandemic relief, and more. Now, she’s running for Congress to represent working families and hold powerful corporations and special interests accountable in this diverse district that also happens to be home to Wall Street itself. Big money donors and the billionaire class are hoping we fail. But we’ve seen what can happen when our grassroots movement bands together to take on corporate interests. Time after time, we’ve shown that when we put in the resources and the time, we can win critical races like this even when our candidates are outspent. body:
Today I'm suspending my campaign for Congress. |
---
| | **Today I’m suspending my campaign. ** I’ll be as honest with you now as I hope I’ve been throughout this process.
I’m sad. I’m really angry - with myself and with politics. I’m so disappointed. Disappointed that I’ve let people down. But I never wanted to run just to run. I wanted to run to win, and unfortunately I just don’t have the capacity to continue.
As I’ve said throughout this campaign, love requires accountability. While a part of me wants to rage quit and grandstand about everything that worked against me, I'd rather be honest with you about where I simply was not able to do enough.
I ran out of money. I didn’t give myself enough time to build the requisite campaign infrastructure to be as competitive as I needed to be. I didn’t knock enough doors. I didn’t spend enough time on the phone. I wasn’t able to organize in the way I wanted or needed to. **That’s entirely on me.**
I could go over every should’ve and could’ve for a long time, and they will certainly keep me up at night for a while. But none of that compares to the depth of gratitude I feel.
To every person who sent me a single dime; every reporter who sat patiently while I excitedly rambled on about the Farm Bill; every person who answered the phone or the door; every person who coached me up on a policy issue, sent me a letter, an email, and cared enough to engage with me - I cannot thank you enough. If you have already voted for me, I’m sorry I’ve breached your trust in this way. Know that I did not make this decision lightly and I’m so grateful that you saw something in me, just a kid from Vermont.

Because early voting has already begun, I'm getting this message out as broadly and quickly as possible. I was not able to call everyone I probably should have, but please be on the lookout for a call or letter from me in the coming days.
I’ll close by saying that although my campaign wasn’t able to come together for this race, I’m not going anywhere. If you find yourself in Essex, send me a note! I’d love to see you here, or anywhere across this beautiful state that has always been and always will be my home.
Thank you for daring greatly with me.
Love always, Sianay

Friend, Social Security is arguably the most important program in our country. Prior to the implementation of Social Security, only wealthy Americans were able to retire. Since it was implemented, the program has ensured that middle class Americans can retire comfortably. **** Many Republicans claim that social security is an unearned entitlement. This couldn’t be further from the truth. The reality is Social Security is vital to our community. **** About a third of our population in Congressional District 19 is over 65, and Social Security is vital to ensuring that they can retire comfortably. It also keeps younger Southwest Floridians, especially women, able to remain part of the workforce instead of caring for elderly relatives. **** Make no mistake, funding Social Security is a political choice. Byron Donalds and his allies in the GOP want to destroy our Social Security system, which would damage our economy and worsen the lives of many Floridians. **** Social Security should not be changed. | | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

body:
Join us in calling on AG Dave Yost to resign
| Team,

Hours after the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost rushed to implement one of the most extreme anti-abortion laws in the country. It didn’t take long for Ohioans to see the cruelty of this decision.

In response to the heartbreaking story of the ten-year-old Ohio girl who had to travel to Indiana to terminate her pregnancy, Attorney General Dave Yost went on national TV and publicly accused the young girl of lying.

He also claimed that “if the story were true,” the ten-year-old girl should’ve still been able to receive treatment in Ohio under the new law, pointing to supposed exceptions. **Yost was wrong on both counts.**

Yost doesn’t even understand the details of the law he's implementing. No physician in Ohio could’ve provided abortion services to the ten-year-old without seriously risking a felony.

**Attorney General Dave Yost continues to spread disinformation and refuses to offer an apology to the victim. Yost is not qualified to serve as Ohio's Attorney General any longer.**

Give us a moment to explain why re-electing Michael and defeating Joe O’Dea is so important, **[then pitch in a $10 donation to the Bennet Defense Fund to keep Colorado blue and defend our slim Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48046344/356689151/99707613?refcode2=1f70778f-9a07-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220719_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjcwNzc4Zi05YTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MQYu4cj0mCDLSNTFYrkfZZJJxi7COMMFN0Ty8wirTX4=)** We don’t like to beg for donations or use scare tactics like “the sky is falling," because you're as much a part of the team as the staff here at headquarters, and the work it takes to keep Colorado blue and defend Michael's seat is deeply personal. This incredible team is made up of generous grassroots donors, dedicated supporters, and committed staff and volunteers and we’re all here for similar reasons:
* We believe that **every child should have a fighting chance** , no matter where they grow up.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48046345/356689152/99707613?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220719_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjcwNzc4Zi05YTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MQYu4cj0mCDLSNTFYrkfZZJJxi7COMMFN0Ty8wirTX4=)
* We believe that we should **enshrine a woman's right to choose** into federal law, because your zip code shouldn't determine your options.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48046346/356689153/99707613?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220719_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjcwNzc4Zi05YTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MQYu4cj0mCDLSNTFYrkfZZJJxi7COMMFN0Ty8wirTX4=)
* We believe **health care should be affordable** and no one should have to choose between taking care of their health and keeping a roof over their heads.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48046347/356689154/99707613?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220719_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjcwNzc4Zi05YTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MQYu4cj0mCDLSNTFYrkfZZJJxi7COMMFN0Ty8wirTX4=)
* We know that **climate change is a real and urgent threat** to our way of life, and that we have the power to fight it.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48046348/356689155/99707613?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220719_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjcwNzc4Zi05YTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MQYu4cj0mCDLSNTFYrkfZZJJxi7COMMFN0Ty8wirTX4=)
* We believe in the **power of our democracy** and that we should leave it stronger for the next generation.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48046349/356689156/99707613?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220719_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjcwNzc4Zi05YTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MQYu4cj0mCDLSNTFYrkfZZJJxi7COMMFN0Ty8wirTX4=) **_And we know Michael refuses to accept that our economy and democracy are too broken to fix and he always puts Colorado first over partisan games._** This campaign is about building on Michael’s progress on the issues Coloradans care about the most: lowering costs, strengthening our economy, increasing opportunities for the next generation, and more. We don’t need to use scare tactics when Joe O'Dea and the National GOP are threats to health care coverage, reproductive freedom, and voting rights as one of their leaders wants to raise taxes on low-income Americans. The National GOP is all-in on Joe O’Dea and they already gave his campaign $46,500 from their $100 million+ war chest to help his campaign and flip our state. clean_body: The work it takes to keep Colorado blue and defend Michael's seat is deeply personal. | = Joe O'Dea is the Republican party’s nominee to flip Michael’s seat. Give us a moment to explain why re-electing Michael and defeating Joe O’Dea is so important, = We don’t like to beg for donations or use scare tactics like “the sky is falling," because you're as much a part of the team as the staff here at headquarters, and the work it takes to keep Colorado blue and defend Michael's seat is deeply personal. This incredible team is made up of generous grassroots donors, dedicated supporters, and committed staff and volunteers and we’re all here for similar reasons: We believe that every child should have a fighting chance , no matter where they grow up. = We believe that we should enshrine a woman's right to choose into federal law, because your zip code shouldn't determine your options. = We believe health care should be affordable and no one should have to choose between taking care of their health and keeping a roof over their heads. = We know that climate change is a real and urgent threat to our way of life, and that we have the power to fight it. = We believe in the power of our democracy and that we should leave it stronger for the next generation. = And we know Michael refuses to accept that our economy and democracy are too broken to fix and he always puts Colorado first over partisan games. This campaign is about building on Michael’s progress on the issues Coloradans care about the most: lowering costs, strengthening our economy, increasing opportunities for the next generation, and more. We don’t need to use scare tactics when Joe O'Dea and the National GOP are threats to health care coverage, reproductive freedom, and voting rights as one of their leaders wants to raise taxes on low-income Americans. The National GOP is all-in on Joe O’Dea and they already gave his campaign $46,500 from their $100 million+ war chest to help his campaign and flip our state. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

As governor, Stacey Abrams will expand
Medicaid because it will do so much good for the people of Georgia. We’re
counting on your support today so that, together, we can:

* Give Georgians access to affordable, quality health care
* Create 64,000 jobs across the state of Georgia — the single largest
economic development in our state’s history
* Keep rural hospitals open
* And more

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220719_B1_Medicaid_S1_T1_HQ_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1051%2E1862389%2EES6pj- ]Derek,
Stacey is running for governor because she
cares about all Georgians and will fight for them every day. Please chip
in today so we can win in November and get to work.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220719_B1_Medicaid_S1_T1_HQ_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=1051%2E1862389%2EES6pj- ]DONATE

Georgia has spent four years under Brian Kemp, who insists on saying no to
helping our own people.

Georgia is entitled to $3.5 billion each year from the federal government
to expand Medicaid. But Kemp has said no to $3.5 billion that we already
have that would have kept rural hospitals open.

No to $3.5 billion that would save Georgia billions on uncompensated care
as people go to the hospital and cannot afford to pay the bill.

And he continues to say no, refusing to take action even as Georgia’s
overreliance on travel nurses continues to drive up costs.

Already, 38 states — under Democratic and Republican leadership — have
expanded Medicaid. Jan Brewer in Arizona did it, and so did John Kasich in
Ohio. Even Mike Pence expanded Medicaid in Indiana. We don’t agree on
much, but for these Republican governors and several more, expanding
Medicaid is not a partisan issue. It was and is just the right thing to
do.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220719_B1_Medicaid_S1_T1_HQ_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=1051%2E1862389%2EES6pj- ]The good news is we can change this. But first, we have to win in
November. Derek,
if you are with us in this fight, can you
make your first
donation to power our campaign right now?

Thanks for all you do,

Stacey Abrams HQ

clean_body: [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor Derek, As governor, Stacey Abrams will expand Medicaid because it will do so much good for the people of Georgia. We’re counting on your support today so that, together, we can: Give Georgians access to affordable, quality health care Create 64,000 jobs across the state of Georgia — the single largest economic development in our state’s history Keep rural hospitals open And more [ - ]Derek, Stacey is running for governor because she cares about all Georgians and will fight for them every day. Please chip in today so we can win in November and get to work. [ - ]DONATE Georgia has spent four years under Brian Kemp, who insists on saying no to helping our own people. Georgia is entitled to $3.5 billion each year from the federal government to expand Medicaid. But Kemp has said no to $3.5 billion that we already have that would have kept rural hospitals open. No to $3.5 billion that would save Georgia billions on uncompensated care as people go to the hospital and cannot afford to pay the bill. And he continues to say no, refusing to take action even as Georgia’s overreliance on travel nurses continues to drive up costs. Already, 38 states — under Democratic and Republican leadership — have expanded Medicaid. Jan Brewer in Arizona did it, and so did John Kasich in Ohio. Even Mike Pence expanded Medicaid in Indiana. We don’t agree on much, but for these Republican governors and several more, expanding Medicaid is not a partisan issue. It was and is just the right thing to do. [ - ]The good news is we can change this. But first, we have to win in November. Derek, if you are with us in this fight, can you make your first donation to power our campaign right now? name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Add your name: Slash the military budget
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Congress should NOT be increasing an already bloated pentagon budget.
#
Peter, the U.S. House passed yet another military budget increase last week: $808 billion. That’s billions more than any of Trump’s military budgets. And it’s billions more than last year’s military spending bill.
**I voted NO on the military budget.** Congress should NOT be increasing an already bloated pentagon budget. It should be spending money on guaranteeing health care for all, funding clean energy, raising wages, investing in child care and education, fighting for our unions and labor protections, and so much more.
[**If you agree, please add your name to my call to cut the military budget by 10% and invest in our people and our planet. We must send a message to Washington D.C. that health care, education, and clean energy are our priorities.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/slash-military-budget/?source=em20220719-1438&t=1&akid=1438%2E420207%2EaF_4zE)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/slash-military-budget/?source=em20220719-1438&t=2&akid=1438%2E420207%2EaF_4zE)**
I’ve championed a 10% cut to the defense budget for years. I voted with more than 70 of my colleagues to slash the budget. $80+ billion could do so much for our country, at a time when we must invest in our public health infrastructure, our fight against climate change, and our social safety net.
**Our country must redefine and reimagine what it means to be strong.** Being strong is NOT giving more money to a bloated Pentagon budget that is already larger than the following 11 countries’ military budgets combined. Our fight for transformative change is only as powerful as the grassroots movement behind it. Are you with me?
[**Sign on today to call on Congress to slash the military budget and fund health care, climate, education, and child care initiatives.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/slash-military-budget/?source=em20220719-1438&t=3&akid=1438%2E420207%2EaF_4zE)

Thank you for fighting for a better future.
In solidarity,
Pramila

body:
The Sierra Club announced their endorsements and... | | |
---
| | Team Brenda is so excited to receive an endorsement from Sierra Club! Brenda, like the Sierra Club, understands that mitigating climate change and finding solutions for limiting pollution is an intersectional issue, and can’t be solved without looking at all aspects of the problem. We need to work towards policies that help all Vermonters, protect our natural resources, and guarantee a future for generations to come. This is why the Sierra Club, and Vermonters across the state, are supporting Brenda. "As a grassroots organization, Sierra Club appreciates Brenda Siegel's ability to effectively organize while building meaningful relationships with elected leaders and grassroots advocates. Vermont needs leaders that put people and the planet first and do not pander to business as usual.” Said Robb Kidd, Program Manager VT Sierra Club Conservation, “Brenda has and will continue to fight for all Vermonters whether it is for affordable housing, clean transportation, or the overdose crisis. Sierra Club believes Brenda has the skill to defeat a Governor that is failing to work with Vermonters to establish real-world solutions and the right experience to lead in this critical moment for Vermont." Our campaign has been receiving grassroots support from across the state, and we can’t do it without generous donations from Vermonters.**[ Support Brenda today with a donation of $50. ](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=c249c8d7cc&e=eb0e94ee98)**

name: Ben, Team NDRC
subject: These races are too important to ignore.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee
body:
I wanted to lay out for you why some of the down-ballot races we’re targeting are so important.
|
---

---
This email is a little longer, team, but I promise it’s important.

With the midterms getting closer and closer, a lot of folks are focusing primarily on federal races. So I wanted to take a second to lay out for you why some of the down-ballot races we’re targeting this year — like state legislative races, secretary of state races, and state supreme court races — are so important to the future of our democracy.

[_But if you already know you want to help support pro-democracy candidates up _and_ down the ballot as part of our fight for fair maps, you can click here to pitch in to the NDRC right now._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48047168/356693994/1479146301?amount=20&refcode=20220718.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwYTZjMDVkLTlkMDctZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5avyKL_14A3OqNrskgT24nSH0PxKo2B299k4QQtLZlY=)

**First, winning state level offices will be crucial to continuing the fight against gerrymandering.** Even though we’ve made some progress with fair redistricting amendments, in many states, the legislature still draws the maps and the governor still approves them. Plus, the GOP has been working to install state supreme court justices they think will rubber stamp their manipulated maps. In order to ensure fair maps going forward, we need to help elect pro-democracy candidates instead.

**Second, making sure Democrats who will fight for voting rights win key state offices is one of the best ways to stop GOP voter suppression, regardless of what Congress does.** Republicans have used their power in state legislatures, combined with their control of secretary of state offices, to further restrict voting rights and regularly purge voters from the rolls. It’s up to us to help flip offices like those and put an end to these blatantly anti-democratic practices.

**Third, winning state level offices will provide an important bulwark against GOP attempts to overturn a legitimate election.** Donald Trump’s strategy to overturn the 2020 election hinged on asking state legislatures to send “alternate” (read: fake) slates of electors for Congress to count. Making sure pro-democracy candidates are in charge of state legislatures and governor’s offices in battleground states will be crucial in stopping their attempts.

**And fourth, a huge number of important decisions on issues like abortion rights, LGBTQ rights, gun safety laws, and more are decided at the state level.** Electing pro-democracy candidates up _and_ down the ballot is a prerequisite to making progress on every issue Democrats care about, which is just one more reason we’re targeting so many state level offices this year.

So while there’s been a heavy amount of attention placed on Democrats’ chances of holding Congress this November, the truth is that the fight to save our democracy is playing out in state capitals all over the country, too. We’re working as hard as possible to help elect pro-democracy candidates in 17 target states this November — but we’re counting on your help to do it.

**So folks, with the future of our democracy hanging in the balance, please make a donation of any amount right now to help us keep up our work. These races, and all NDRC’s pro-democracy work, are just too important to ignore.** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

clean_body: I wanted to lay out for you why some of the down-ballot races we’re targeting are so important. | This email is a little longer, team, but I promise it’s important. With the midterms getting closer and closer, a lot of folks are focusing primarily on federal races. So I wanted to take a second to lay out for you why some of the down-ballot races we’re targeting this year — like state legislative races, secretary of state races, and state supreme court races — are so important to the future of our democracy. = First, winning state level offices will be crucial to continuing the fight against gerrymandering. Even though we’ve made some progress with fair redistricting amendments, in many states, the legislature still draws the maps and the governor still approves them. Plus, the GOP has been working to install state supreme court justices they think will rubber stamp their manipulated maps. In order to ensure fair maps going forward, we need to help elect pro-democracy candidates instead. Second, making sure Democrats who will fight for voting rights win key state offices is one of the best ways to stop GOP voter suppression, regardless of what Congress does. Republicans have used their power in state legislatures, combined with their control of secretary of state offices, to further restrict voting rights and regularly purge voters from the rolls. It’s up to us to help flip offices like those and put an end to these blatantly anti-democratic practices. Third, winning state level offices will provide an important bulwark against GOP attempts to overturn a legitimate election. Donald Trump’s strategy to overturn the 2020 election hinged on asking state legislatures to send “alternate” (read: fake) slates of electors for Congress to count. Making sure pro-democracy candidates are in charge of state legislatures and governor’s offices in battleground states will be crucial in stopping their attempts. And fourth, a huge number of important decisions on issues like abortion rights, LGBTQ rights, gun safety laws, and more are decided at the state level. Electing pro-democracy candidates up and down the ballot is a prerequisite to making progress on every issue Democrats care about, which is just one more reason we’re targeting so many state level offices this year. So while there’s been a heavy amount of attention placed on Democrats’ chances of holding Congress this November, the truth is that the fight to save our democracy is playing out in state capitals all over the country, too. We’re working as hard as possible to help elect pro-democracy candidates in 17 target states this November — but we’re counting on your help to do it. So folks, with the future of our democracy hanging in the balance, please make a donation of any amount right now to help us keep up our work. I just voted for myself and Michelle Siri for Governor and Lieutenant Governor...

| Hey Peter, I just stepped out of my polling place in Silver Spring, where I just voted for myself and Michelle Siri for Governor and Lieutenant Governor. Truly, it was one of the most surreal and humbling moments of my life. And it was even more fulfilling to have experienced this moment alongside my wife Melissa and my two daughters, Mireya and Amina — and this was Amina’s very first time voting! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48047321/356694881/-1514526794?source=email-ngp-vol&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&utm_campaign=vol&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmE2YzA1ZC05ZDA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WwekS4ANnbYtxAUXRuXAyHdJPKhN2D6D7z21yudi7jA=&emci=2e7e1320-c106-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6ba6c05d-9d07-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484) First and foremost, I want to express my gratitude to all of you. When we first launched this campaign, I never could have imagined the incredible showing of support and record-breaking momentum that we have received over the past year and a half. I’ve crisscrossed the state, made lifelong friends, heard your stories, and shared in the hope of a better future. **It’s been one of the most rewarding times of my life, and it’s all thanks to you.** But this race is not over yet, and I have just one more ask of you. If you haven’t voted yet, please head to the polls! And if you have cast your ballot, make sure your friends and family do the same. All the work we’ve done comes down to this moment, so it’s critical that we turn out as many supporters as possible. Again, and from the bottom of my heart, thank you. Let’s finish strong! clean_body: I just voted for myself and Michelle Siri for Governor and Lieutenant Governor... | Hey Peter, I just stepped out of my polling place in Silver Spring, where I just voted for myself and Michelle Siri for Governor and Lieutenant Governor. Truly, it was one of the most surreal and humbling moments of my life. And it was even more fulfilling to have experienced this moment alongside my wife Melissa and my two daughters, Mireya and Amina — and this was Amina’s very first time voting! First and foremost, I want to express my gratitude to all of you. When we first launched this campaign, I never could have imagined the incredible showing of support and record-breaking momentum that we have received over the past year and a half. I’ve crisscrossed the state, made lifelong friends, heard your stories, and shared in the hope of a better future. It’s been one of the most rewarding times of my life, and it’s all thanks to you. But this race is not over yet, and I have just one more ask of you. If you haven’t voted yet, please head to the polls! And if you have cast your ballot, make sure your friends and family do the same. All the work we’ve done comes down to this moment, so it’s critical that we turn out as many supporters as possible. Again, and from the bottom of my heart, thank you. Let’s finish strong! John King Sent from my iPhone P.S. name: Ken Hamm
subject: Support Heidi St. John!
body:
Hi Peter,

The email below is from me and my wife,
personally.

Are you concerned about what's happening to
the America that we love? I know we are. It's no secret that
our Nation is in trouble. We have a leadership crisis in the
United States, from our school boards to the White House.

The Bible teaches us that we are engaged in a
spiritual battle-and spiritual battles require spiritual weapons.
That means Christians should engage in this battle. Yes, it's
God's Word and the gospel that changes hearts, but our
responsibility is also to be salt and light so we can impact
policies that shape our nation including the freedoms we have
enjoyed.

These battles also require every one of us to
help-and help is on the way!

I'm excited that my friend, Heidi St. John,
has decided to run for Congress in Washington State. Heidi has
been on the front lines advocating for freedom and families from
a biblical worldview for decades. She's proven that she's ready
to lead in Congress! She has already made great sacrifices to do
this. Now, she needs our help.

Remember that Heidi's voice in Congress will
be a voice for all of us!

So, here's the thing: it's just a few days
now until the Washington primary and we have a burden to help our
friend Heidi get her message out on television and radio. As you
know, ads are expensive, but if you will join me, we can help her
across the finish line.

Heidi always says that "it's time to get off
the bench and onto the battlefield" and I agree! It's time for
all hands on deck. She really needs to raise 30k in the next 72
hours.

If 30 people will give $1k or 60 at $500, we
can do it quickly! You get the idea.

Let's be part of a massive shakeup so needed
in American politics. I hope you'll join Mally and me in
supporting our dear friend Heidi St. John for Congress and become
part of the American Revival story.

Here is a link to make
it easy for you.

-- Ken and Mally Ham

Team, Veterans have sacrificed so much to keep us safe and secure. It’s our responsibility to ensure they receive the care and benefits they’ve earned. That’s why I am working with _U.S Vets_ , and other veteran non-profits, to get veterans who are experiencing homelessness the resources they need. Last month, Mesa’s _A New Leaf_ and Prescott’s _United States Veterans Initiative_ were awarded funds to help provide mental health support, work training opportunities, and nutrition assistance to veterans experiencing homelessness in Arizona communities. We’re also working to pass the _Elizabeth Dole Home Care Act,_ bipartisan legislation that will help ensure that home- and community-based care programs have the necessary resources to support veterans in need of assistance. As we continue our work to support Arizona service members, veterans, and their families, I hope you’ll join me in recognizing and honoring them for their service and sacrifice. We’re also working to pass the Elizabeth Dole Home Care Act, bipartisan legislation that will help ensure that home- and community-based care programs have the necessary resources to support veterans in need of assistance. As we continue our work to support Arizona service members, veterans, and their families, I hope you’ll join me in recognizing and honoring them for their service and sacrifice. | Thank you, Kyrsten Sinema for Arizona P.O.
