subject: URGENT: Speak up in support of clean fuels!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters and authorized by Andrea Salinas for Congress
body:
| | | Dear Peter, Now is the time to speak up on behalf of our state and planet at large. Oregon’s Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) has opened the stage for public comment in support of expanding the Clean Fuels Program (CFP) in Oregon, and **[_we need you to ask them for a bigger, bolder CFP by the deadline on July 21st at 4:00 PM. _](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48048379/356700283/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyMDJjNjYyLWEzMDctZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EgUmIYrsX1y_W2XYqrD0-4GPlD1062PS_rZ-ejxC658=&emci=a5d103df-8707-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6202c662-a307-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** The program, which reduces carbon pollution from vehicles, has already been wildly successful, as it has shaved over 6 million tons of pollution from Oregon’s atmosphere for a healthier climate. Expanding the CFP could make it our state’s most important piece of climate action in 2022. DEQ is looking to grow the scope of Oregon’s Clean Fuels Program, but big oil is doing everything they can to ensure that Oregon’s CFP is weakened to undercut its climate benefits and protect corporate profits. This is why we **need** you to fight for the CFP to include: -**An increase in the targets for cutting carbon density, shooting for reductions above and beyond the previous goals of 20% below 2015 emission levels by 2030 and 37% below 2015 emission levels by 2035.** The less carbon in our atmosphere due to clean energy, the better! -**A commitment to achieving a reduction in emissions primarily through the use of electric energy** for a cleaner, healthier climate in Oregon. -**Concrete plans for funding and increasing access to clean energy infrastructure for rural and low income communities and for those living on tribal reservations, as well as Oregon’s BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, people of color) population overall.** Those who are too-often slighted by structural inequality and our governing bodies deserve healthy living environments too! You may be asking– why aren't the already-proposed climate goals of the CFP enough? Between drought, wildfire, and heat waves, Oregon has witnessed harmful climate disasters that will _continue and worsen if we don’t take increasingly drastic climate action and transition to clean energy as soon as possible._ Humanity is at the tipping point for taking action on climate change, so **[_we must urge the DEQ to go bigger in their plans to reduce carbon pollution from Oregon’s cars and trucks, and at a more rapid pace than what has been proposed._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48048380/356700284/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyMDJjNjYyLWEzMDctZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EgUmIYrsX1y_W2XYqrD0-4GPlD1062PS_rZ-ejxC658=&emci=a5d103df-8707-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6202c662-a307-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** I’m sure you’re tired of high gas prices gouged by out-of-state fossil fuel companies retaliating against climate protections. This is why it is vital that _**[we use our voices to speak up in support of expanding the CFP](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48048381/356700285/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyMDJjNjYyLWEzMDctZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EgUmIYrsX1y_W2XYqrD0-4GPlD1062PS_rZ-ejxC658=&emci=a5d103df-8707-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6202c662-a307-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** ,_ as it will help guarantee price stability for electric energy homed in-state as opposed to volatility determined by distant oil companies and foreign conflict. Finally, the CFP will create employment opportunities for jobs in clean energy, as well as drive innovation in eco-friendly technology and infrastructure, resulting in a cleaner Oregon climate that cuts pollution and its detrimental health impacts. **[_Will you submit written public comment before 4:00 PM on 7/21/22 to push the DEQ to expand the scope and goals of the Clean Fuels Program and safeguard our state from the wrath of the climate crisis as well as the corporate polluters working to exacerbate it?_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48048382/356700286/1409937203?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYyMDJjNjYyLWEzMDctZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EgUmIYrsX1y_W2XYqrD0-4GPlD1062PS_rZ-ejxC658=&emci=a5d103df-8707-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=6202c662-a307-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)** Thank you,
Will Bertellotti, Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

| PRESS RELEASE: SOUTH DAKOTA GOVERNOR KRISTI NOEM TO CAMPAIGN IN SUPPORT OF GEOFF DIEHL FOR GOVERNOR
Kristi Noem, Governor of South Dakota, will travel to Massachusetts in support of Geoff Diehl's campaign for Massachusetts Governor in August.
Governor Noem will arrive in Boston and appear alongside Diehl on the campaign trail on Wednesday, August 10. She also will attend a fundraising event for Diehl at the residence of Ernie Boch, Jr.
---
| | [Donate to Geoff's Campaign for Governor](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012E6-r5RSsYz95katjo0GH8gbVrZ5MH2FYKXU7wR9Vd4TjIo956kuWD9Oske0AwLgAuT32ZBezSwVndBE2ikzoCLTDNFaEPkuGYnY4Fl2B_AXUsofWuBYB3BCa_MSK42WBCQwPaJuedsWO1KlOHPy4DevybKOE5_JwjIA2RfmW323h1bBTx4xfA==&c=0drcWtqLbhEpLF5h72FtaOoQVXgoyHbvkOuhIHO-QRvVN7YurEz6qQ==&ch=IRIkN5Ho3002136UTmD995TN4HMy09m1IO_AFYaahf58E9dl62UvoA==)
---
| "Geoff Diehl is an exciting candidate who promises to bring about a better future for Massachusetts," Governor Noem said in a statement. "He offers a unique blend of conservative credentials, trusted legislative experience, and practical work in the private sector, all of which give him a valuable perspective on how to best serve the needs of Massachusetts residents. I am proud to endorse Geoff Diehl and support his campaign for Governor."
"I am honored and humbled to have the support of Governor Noem, who is such a strong and effective leader for the people of South Dakota," Diehl said. "I thank Governor Noem for offering to come to Massachusetts and join me on the campaign trail. I especially admire her leadership during the pandemic, when she was one of the few leaders in our nation to keep her people safe and keep her state open for business. It is my sincere pleasure to welcome her to the Bay State and to show her everything we are doing to wage our campaign against high taxes and big government."
"It is my distinct honor to host Governor Noem and Geoff Diehl as guests at my home," stated Ernie Boch, Jr. "Governor Noem is one of the most exciting Governors in the country, showing true courage and leadership for the people she represents. Geoff Diehl offers the same hope and opportunity to the people of Massachusetts, and I am proud to support his candidacy."
Geoff Diehl is the Republican Party's officially-endorsed candidate for Governor of Massachusetts.

body:
Republicans continue to mount attacks using the buzzword inflation. It is important to counter false narratives with factual information. Inflation is the result of globalization. Globalization touches every corner of our world. It is not a Democrat-caused issue nor is it a problem that only Republicans can solve.
Inflation is principally driven by these factors:
1. Supply and Demand. Post-pandemic consumer demand for gas and associated goods (while supplies are limited) will result in higher prices.
2. Global Supply Disruptions. COVID-19 lockdowns crippled China’s factories and the global supply chain. China delivered two-thirds of global exports before the pandemic.
3. Russia & Ukraine. Both Russia and Ukraine are global distributors of energy and other commodities; any disruptions in these countries (i.e., a war) will have negative ripple effects around the world.
4. Speculation. Speculation drives inflation as it is an indication of confidence, or a lack there of, in our economy.
5. Corporate Greed and Profiteering. While Democrats institute measures to rein in price-gouging, business and people in the top 1 percent of the income tier for their age or firm size continue to enjoy Trump-era tax breaks and government benefits.

You will hear rhetoric claiming that providing stimulus checks to working people and families largely caused inflation. This is false. We do not have to keep people poor in order to avoid inflation. We have the capacity to be prosperous in this country. It is unacceptable that the average person can barely afford to keep $400 in their savings account. For me, this signals a broken economic system.
And you need to know the facts!
I’m representing working individuals and families in West Virginia. The incumbent, Carol Miller, has other priorities and they do not include YOU! With your support and your vote, I will fight for all of us!

Let’s change our lives for the better...together!

body:

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: Our Fight to Get Bans Off Our Bodies
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

Please join me and Representative Kathy Manning (D-NC) for a very important grassroots volunteer update on Our Fight to Get Bans Off of Our Bodies. We know this is a scary time for so many. House Democrats remain committed to the fight for our reproductive rights including codifying Roe, data privacy, and our right to travel.

Led by the Pro Choice Women Caucus and many of our younger members of reproductive age, to protect privacy and bodily autonomy, I am very proud of the work of our caucus. I hope you will join us to hear about this work, what has already been done, what else we need to do, and how you can help.

Tomorrow night, my outstanding colleague Congresswoman Kathy Manning from North Carolina will touch on everything that is at stake and what we can and must all do – together – to defend a woman's right to make her own decisions about the timing and size of her family and to protect the privacy rights of all Americans.

Congresswoman Kathy Manning is a proud member of the Education and Labor and Foreign Affairs Committees and serves on the Early Childhood, Elementary, and Secondary Education Subcommittee and the Higher Education and Workforce Investment Subcommittee of the Education and Labor Committee. It is an honor and a pleasure to welcome her to be with us to discuss this very important kitchen table issue for America’s working families.

To you, our volunteers in politics, thank you for your persistence, support, and engagement. Your involvement and your outside mobilization make all the difference in our ability to achieve the progress that we must in order to protect our freedoms together. Democrats will always believe in and fight for our freedoms — that is who we are and what we do!

Please RSVP here:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/2516437726514/WN_s3LaKL1tTm2YVDBpqHUndA

Thank you,

NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

| | | Dear Peter,

This upcoming election is of the utmost importance. Your vote this election will have a **_significant impact_** on the course of America.

With less than 3 weeks left before my primary election, I **_NEED_** your help to make sure our country is **protected** by a Republican majority.

**There is no going back if we allow the Democrats to continue with a majority where Joe Biden and Kamala Harris have tyrannical amounts of unchecked power over our ways of life.**

**Far-Left Democrats like AOC, Bernie Sanders, and Ilhan Omar have consistently downplayed the truth about socialism and its dangerous effects. We cannot allow their radical policies to permanently destroy the future of America.**

Americans have faced **_constant_** restrictions on their constitutional rights and freedoms under the Biden administration and Democrat majority’s rule over the past two years.

**_We cannot allow our free speech, second amendment rights, or the right to life to be limited ANY longer by the government. ._**

This is what is at stake this year.

Friend,

Jen and our entire campaign team are working hard to make every moment of this summer count. Each day is an opportunity to engage with Georgians, tell our story, and advocate for Jen's vision — especially before the airwaves are overrun with misleading attack ads.

That's why we recently made a swing through Southwest Georgia. We kicked things off in Randolph County, where Jen held a meet-and-greet. Folks in Cuthbert came by to chat directly with Jen, learn about ways to get involved in the race, and pick up campaign literature and t-shirts. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48051243/356712306/1460579386?refcode=EM_C_220719SW_N_TJ_FULL_7_G_N_P1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjN2Y0NWQyMy1hZTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E3zVaQJT7JG9tXfE51PYjYnSNTSxCJFJSnUZc41HidQ=) Later on, in Americus, Jen had a great time engaging with voters over morning coffee. Jen is grateful to all who took the time to sit down and share their vision for the Attorney General’s office. She will take their stories and priorities with her — and ensure that they have a voice in state government. Friend,

I won’t lie: When I think about all the terrible things Ron DeSantis has done to Florida and our people during his time as governor, my blood pressure rises. It seems there’s _no end_ to what he’ll do to advance his own political career.

He’s vowed to **eliminate background checks and gun permits** across Florida, putting our children and our families in greater danger.

He signed **the most restrictive anti-choice legislation** in Florida’s history since _Roe v. Wade_ , banning almost all abortions, with no exceptions for horrible situations like rape or incest. It’s a monstrous law, but it won him points with Presidential Republican primary voters, so he supports it.

To put an even finer point in this: Now that the Supreme Court has left the right to choose up to the states, DeSantis refuses to say how far he’ll go to take away reproductive freedom. This has huge impacts not only in Florida, but also for millions of women in the South who might soon be traveling here to exercise their rights.

DeSantis is determined to silence _anyone_ who opposes him. One autocracy expert recently claimed in _POLITICO_ that **DeSantis is trying to turn Florida into his own personal “mini-autocracy.”** He’s even gone after the Special Olympics for going against his backwards political agenda. Sadly, you can’t make this stuff up.

Suffice to say, the stakes could not be higher in this November’s election. With DeSantis eyeing a run for president in 2024, there’s no telling what he’d do with a second term as governor if he thought it would help him get to the White House.

| | Since I’ve entered this race for governor over a year ago, I’ve traveled the state and had the opportunity to meet tens of thousands of Marylanders.

I have been inspired by countless stories which I’ve heard on the trail and the pride that every Marylander has in our beautiful state.

In my travels from Garrett County in Western Maryland to Worcester County on the Eastern Shore, and every place in between, it is clear to me, that overwhelmingly, Marylanders want to keep moving our state in the right direction.

I am the only candidate in this race that will do just that.

Our campaign is focused on delivering you solutions to address the most pressing issues facing our state: [making our streets safe](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=bcc96d4ad9&e=64ac72257a), ensuring that your children receive a [world class education](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=b3d097d3b1&e=64ac72257a), and making Maryland more [affordable](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=a2f6ceed76&e=64ac72257a).

I am the only candidate who is standing in the way of one-party rule in Annapolis, and a tidal wave of tax increases, less support for our law enforcement, and massive spending programs.

As your governor, I am going to fight each and every day to improve your livelihood and to make sure that you and your family can have every opportunity to succeed in Maryland.

Count on it.

**Polls are open on Tuesday, July 19 th until 8 PM and if you haven’t returned you mail-in ballot please have it postmarked by July 19th. **

This election is critical for Maryland’s future and every vote counts. I hope that I can count on your support and earn your vote.

Dear Fellow American, "The Constitution is kind of trash." That's what a guest-with an Ivy League degree-said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You've likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash." And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution-Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison-gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. subject: Standing up for Woodbine Library

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wadewoodbine?refcode=whem0719 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wadewoodbine?refcode=whem0719]
Peter –
I can remember as a boy my mom taking me each week to the Washington Library in Macon and just letting us loose to check out books. Libraries are a place where children discover the joy of reading and a place where adults continue that joy.
But in the digital age, a library is so much more than that – it’s a place for computers, printers, and wifi. A place to look for a job, to apply for vocational school or college, or apply for veteran’s benefits.
This past Friday, I joined Mayor of Woodbine Kizzi Knight, Camden County Democratic Committee Chair Kelvin Blue, and concerned community members to hold a press conference [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wadewoodbine?refcode=whem0719] in support of the efforts to continue funding the Woodbine Library in Camden County Georgia.
Click here to watch the press conference! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wadewoodbine?refcode=whem0719]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wadewoodbine?refcode=whem0719 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wadewoodbine?refcode=whem0719]
On June 23rd, the Camden County Board of Commissioners voted to deny the library the requested $30,000 in operating costs needed to function for the 2023 fiscal year. The library serves over 600 families in the Woodbine area, as well as the northern part of Camden County.
Beyond just books & other materials, the library offers free access to broadband and printers, social programs for children and senior citizens, and savings on a 14-mile trip to the next closest library in Kingsland or St. Mary’s, Georgia.
Libraries are one example of how folks from different generations and walks of life can come together and benefit from the services a public space provides.
In order to improve our communities, we need to invest in our communities and the places that bring folks together.
These are the local issues that matter in this election and I pledge to keep fighting to bring our communities together, not tear them apart.
In service,
Wade Herring

body:

name: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
subject: Hey, it's the SLOP!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
This is a longer email from me, but I hope you read it
#
Hi Derek,
Our campaign has grown quickly since John won the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate, but I wanted to take a minute to introduce myself, in case we haven’t met yet.
I’m Gisele Barreto Fetterman, the Second Lady of Pennsylvania. Or, as I like to call myself, the SLOP. 😂
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220719-1?refcode=em20220719-6573&refcode2=6573_434096_og-VJw&akid=6573%2E434096%2Eog-VJw)
_Here I am on Election Night filling in for João._
This is the story of me and John — but it gets a little long. **[If you don’t have the time to read this all right now, please consider making a donation of any amount towards our campaign today. No amount is too little to make a difference.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220719-1?refcode=em20220719-6573&refcode2=6573_434096_og-VJw&akid=6573%2E434096%2Eog-VJw)**
I met John many years, three kids, and two dogs ago — before he was Pennsylvania’s next senator. Back then, he was just a guy trying to pour love into Braddock, a small steel town that helped build America, but had been left behind. He moved there to teach GED classes, and after two of his students were gunned down, he ran for mayor to stop the violence and bring back jobs.
I read about the work John was doing, and I was inspired. Long story short? I joined him in Braddock, he fell madly in love with me, we got married, and we’ve been working together ever since to make sure no one is left behind.
But really, though. I immigrated to this country with my mom when I was just a kid. I was a DREAMer. And when our son August heard that, he asked me: “Mommy, what did you dream about?” 😭
I told him: I dreamt about him. And that was true. But also, **I dreamt about all of this.**
Like so many others, I found the American dream, and made my life in Western Pennsylvania. I found love, a wonderful family, and a place I am proud to raise my children. **John and I want to make sure that everyone in Pennsylvania can find the American dream here, too.**
On the surface, John and I don’t seem like we’d have a lot in common. (According to the zodiac we are only 11% compatible — of course I checked!)
But what connected us then — and what connects us now — is a shared conviction: **no person should be left behind, and no community should be forgotten.**
John has always stood out. My grandmother Bibi used to say he had to be made that tall because it was the only way to fit his whole heart. ❤️
But it’s not just his height, his goatee, or his refusal to wear long pants — even when I beg him to — that make him different. It’s not just because John looks nothing like a politician (and is deliriously handsome, but don’t tell him I said that).
It’s because John doesn’t _act_ like a politician. At heart, he's still that hardworking, scrappy, small-town mayor. He wants to know the people he’s serving. He feels a responsibility to each and every one of them. And he fights for people like he’d fight for a neighbor, like he’d fight for our family.
**That is what makes John different. And that is what makes him tough enough to fight for Pennsylvania.**
He did it in Braddock. He did it in Harrisburg. And now, he’s going to do the same thing in Washington.
Now, I’m going to be honest with you. Politics is mean — and I’m not. But the truth is, too many people in this commonwealth and this country are hurting. Too many people feel abandoned and ignored. Too many people think their best days are behind them. Nothing is more cruel than the feeling of being hopeless.
But John has a plan and a purpose to make sure Pennsylvania’s best days are ahead of us.
He’s going to fight for abortion rights.
He’s going to fight to raise the minimum wage and protect the union way of life.
He’s going to fight to protect our planet.
He’s going to fight to eliminate the filibuster.
He’s going to fight to legalize cannabis.
He’s going to fight against gun violence.
He’s going to fight against inflation and corporate greed.
And he’s going to fight so this country starts making things in America again — the way it once did in Braddock.
Of course, the general election is less than four months away. And because Pennsylvania is our #1 chance to pick up a Democratic seat in the Senate, this race will likely be the biggest, most competitive, and most watched race in the country.
_It might also be the nastiest._
Now that John’s officially up against Dr. Oz, there’s going to be more dark money, more negative ads, more lies spread about him than most of us can imagine.
Fortunately, John is up to the challenge. But he can’t do it alone.
**He needs your help to fight back.**
**[So please, if you can, please make a donation of any amount today to support John’s campaign for U.S. Senate. John has always had our backs — now it’s time we have his.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220719-1?refcode=em20220719-6573&refcode2=6573_434096_og-VJw&akid=6573%2E434096%2Eog-VJw)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220719-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220719-6573&refcode2=6573_434096_og-VJw&akid=6573%2E434096%2Eog-VJw)**
This race we’re running — it’s a race for the future of every community across Pennsylvania. For every small town, for every person who calls those small towns home, and for every person who’s considered leaving because they just didn’t see enough opportunities.
It’s a race for every job that’s been lost, for every factory that’s been closed, for every cost that keeps rising, and every worker who can’t keep up.
It’s a race for a better Pennsylvania, a better country.
And it’s a race that, together, we will win in November!
Thank you for taking the time to read this. Your support means the world to me, John, our family, and this whole campaign.
With love and gratitude,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220719-1?refcode=em20220719-6573&refcode2=6573_434096_og-VJw&akid=6573%2E434096%2Eog-VJw)

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220719-6573-footer&t=1&refcode2=6573_434096_og-VJw&akid=6573%2E434096%2Eog-VJw)**

Email us: info@johnfetterman.com
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Fetterman for PA, PO Box 6061, Pittsburgh PA 15211.

Nan is ready to do what it takes to enshrine the protections from Roe into the Ohio constitution, and to veto any bill restricting access to reproductive care.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48044579/356681088/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjk5NjdjNi05MTA3LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qKKfUOF-bwcS5s_8d1LmFH81ZDO0M6GpiJBb-HeJxLM=)

Team,
Abortion rights are on the ballot this year – and Democrats are fired up.
Republicans in Ohio, and across the country, are coming for reproductive rights, including the right to safe, legal abortion care. **We’re fighting back.**

| | Fellow American,

When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”

_I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House._

In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. **But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in.**

If we haven't met yet, [**I'm Nancy Mace**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatqls6Zu0kAhArBlwGOWEuthIxIK6puYEH7EoA_SLE_d7xlxRP10q3thUY3cu1S8UfsBsD7ViC5PdOltA1Dupo4ix95llInOFUJPHZ0uBZVDKAaNhdHf3akCB1wYGiHoc-rtuRa2Yk0ezwh8JLiCXAGeKJAfnrwvwx0YnBaZfws4Ie_hVtB9RtKu9nPXL8iRclv6a5GRWcmUg-BSQvAUCb863w%3D%3D). I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America!

I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina.

In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red.

**I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as[we continue on the path to re-election](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatqln-X-Qe3XlUu4CzfeMKSAspdLGOVBFQtl6qrZy4vRi6NIUYVQMmmTFi_XC2KYpr2JYSj1kbj3C2uKh14-kiels7IyqEYguaBzF59DuRfZXvggSCqHxJSfw__91LcovcxDJiRw4X4SYrbHKEBapG8kRCerTdprlPSKobvr1K9TmeXBxBIYNJltMd0W2Lr1xYjI7i0mv1wOHD_JzDBxEWg9Tg%3D%3D).**

[**Will you chip in whatever you can – whether it's $75, $50, or $10, so that I can win this race and restore our country.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatqlI20Mn5oVL4iP84-omxDcf3j7ZtnOxIuEjnCaaGlWSbn8NwF7sfQeFih_zNF6RbcD7vVklo1jf7Abrybu8JtWuOwvhLTR20-qEZKmeoBnrBU5LTVoX9QO8jqmPiWq2JLSmdsUDItqm_MPLrAMfuGzuT3f0vyCY2qKpmxn6m0lsojIBPjMGId_sjG-twqzm_v7I8U7odzSfpTQoBx_8JbKTA%3D%3D)

[ ** Chip In ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatqlZG05WAfJvqCIk1FuYHl5765scpebgZ1tzPbqXwsmPI0GFmRzK3jDHVEFSAX4EeLWomOwSzpmn9EtPwOJt6_ijHO6qX0P7a7bNthaCzOP663JivNDxWEYTId5jm6Q6eCyOdFwFDk-jVU1TOFfcRusgvl0z9-B-W9IJI3ssrr6U8ahGnuyBSHddemV4VPF1LBP8cg7R-0nOQc-C0IpCpmtxQ%3D%3D)

There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, _let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress._

I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much.

I'm proud of my conservative record and I'm proud of delivering results day in and day out for the Lowcountry. I'm proud I've never voted to raise your taxes. And as the daughter of a veteran, I'm proud of the work I've done to help our veterans throughout South Carolina. **Serving the Lowcountry is the honor of my lifetime.**

[**_Which is why I'm asking for your help to continue doing my job and serving you._** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatqlHjzeD6sxHcYb_BSaJON2YOAE0A_NhC1VqnlTOUsrL4whWBJOK_cv0Q2HcEgokGUqjpUGit8ycFR9faerKhlhaZfZ-QUoYLeUl3xx7h9FMqjTQgX2waWc89ARSo13gs2kz-xoB2J1CwfOCzDQeqFfQxiNj1wXtEjUFIVN9QA1ENOt4jWoj9n0EzGaPbXkc9lWfFE9XTcP2inS-YzQAcbd7w%3D%3D) [ ** KEEP THE FIRST ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatql9--kO-v8mtrqw30GEmVeFYvwUO2s3m6-vPgEsIvOZQluYJmLQ3v_v9VFZqutbAOkjg_dbnF95dAtIsOzcSEG53-PBFpfHyvY12KJbwKavTejObRcZ5EjJoWb2JTpSHR_iD4VpzS8doINqGhgYq5t0hOG_tu4XqDbQ7Jql09o0bwt-Aziv6bzqhE2yaBukQ0RpCSn5OgLikkQ2eSrRz90NA%3D%3D)

What's happening in America right now is _horrifying_. Kids are being used as political pawns, radical liberal ideas are becoming mainstream, the woke media is prioritizing clicks and view over the truth, and our so-called ‘leaders' have sold themselves out for fame and fortune.

As Americans, we deserve __so much better than this__. It's time to restore our economy, secure the southern border, put parents back in charge, support our military, and reestablish pride in our country.

[**It's time to stand up and say enough is enough! I'm running for re-election because I believe I'm the woman who can help save our country.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatqlLHdKeZY8G3gCM7d5smzCzs5YsdWL9gUpMacoT3x5gIQ54SdC8S945r5LGik1TfjbteBVz9yQrNCJpcjrvA6o_8ZamphBBJkg9HDBCWKyTPj_W_yWCIFEzoFcwtTqlYVCpYOi9ZSRjTWpq3GeU6nN-kRzroQRjo9oYzKnvE20SgZuzEwVYsl6Afcv20FEAm-V27a9CyQgztZCdadmpSHr2A%3D%3D) I'm in Washington week in and week out, fighting for you and your family – I have a 100% record of voting to lower taxes and a 100% lifetime rating with Conservation Voters of South Carolina!

[ ** SEND NANCY TO CONGRESS ➞ **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=028470f3aafb45e4afcac3e87a33e212&_e=gS5XkSDNw95907cq6CxkAFB9HN_lAkytktmKBg_u695hwM5DJCcpA9zuJV_MuYqqBrSWaWPtL1vk9MN5jo5CAmXLzkLwdaQSo1fNQlgJzTA_uN3e4tgxV8g2o633ohC0naQSPjw7Q03ZK_rv-64HQFJGWv_i1W0M4MKYaK-rDlpxmPZ5xYicDt0Z1SxDYtDEDrBMoQdqzMfhDV1PNgrl_ry9RbWFev6G5vRQFdyaqlleYL61FgmzAuQoz32fatqlSIxvVxHSyAPEP3CU73mLyxdQa7WmygsY0AQZPxooNvPgZesW0qhb9qQolCYNM2_pdXXN55kaNkBW9beEGi4WvMsNMhOvaFDiv9lMykpdTb4Qc_WN5ag6353IZtMx8aqaofgzRW59PLNATHApvr4scTuBGz1wvc9HNGn8f4B-43KsoNgAUbKMtrtfSBtsAELLAMw6wD3PR8rJvvSug-XioA%3D%3D)

I'll leave you with this thought: I believe you can do anything you set your mind to. That's how a high-school drop-out like myself became a Congresswoman. _I believe we can fix our country and leave a stronger nation to the next generation._

Maybe it's how I was raised, or maybe it's just the fighting spirit in me, but I know we can fix the broken system in Washington. clean_body: When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you’re going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”| | | | | | Fellow American, When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.” I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House. In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in. If we haven't met yet, . I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America! I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina. In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red. I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as. There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress. I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much. I'm proud of my conservative record and I'm proud of delivering results day in and day out for the Lowcountry. I'm proud I've never voted to raise your taxes. And as the daughter of a veteran, I'm proud of the work I've done to help our veterans throughout South Carolina. Serving the Lowcountry is the honor of my lifetime. What's happening in America right now is horrifying. Kids are being used as political pawns, radical liberal ideas are becoming mainstream, the woke media is prioritizing clicks and view over the truth, and our so-called ‘leaders' have sold themselves out for fame and fortune. As Americans, we deserve so much better than this. It's time to restore our economy, secure the southern border, put parents back in charge, support our military, and reestablish pride in our country. I'm in Washington week in and week out, fighting for you and your family – I have a 100% record of voting to lower taxes and a 100% lifetime rating with Conservation Voters of South Carolina! I'll leave you with this thought: I believe you can do anything you set your mind to. That's how a high-school drop-out like myself became a Congresswoman. I believe we can fix our country and leave a stronger nation to the next generation. Maybe it's how I was raised, or maybe it's just the fighting spirit in me, but I know we can fix the broken system in Washington. Thank you and God bless, Nancy Mace | | | About Nancy Congresswoman Nancy Mace grew up in the Lowcountry. She is the daughter of a retired Army General and retired school teacher. **I need your immediate attention: Today, Marco Rubio just went live with his first TV ad. **

This new ad – which is also being blasted across the airwaves with the help of Mitch McConnell’s committee – blatantly attacks and distorts my record. It spreads lies about me and my campaign.
**I hate to say it, friend, but ads like this have the potential to change the trajectory of our race for the worse **– particularly when Rubio’s getting a boost from his buddy McConnell. | | **In case you missed our town hall meeting, the Delaware Valley Journal provided terrific coverage!**

_**Nascimento, 48, who is challenging incumbent Rep. Madeleine Dean (D-Montgomery), discussed help for American businesses and keeping the country safe.

“Small businesses are the lifeblood of the American economy,” he said. Supply chain issues are plaguing businesses, including Open Tier Systems, an IT service company that hosted the town hall. That issue, coupled with inflation and the losses from COVID-19 shutdowns, has hit the U.S. economy hard.**_

_**“The president has to be honest. This is not Vladimir Putin’s price hike. You can’t blame all of this on a mad dictator...And Congress blindly goes along with (Biden). The representative that we currently have in this seat (Dean) votes with the president 100 percent of the time. So she owns this.”**_

We all know how important this year's elections are if we want to get America back on track. That's why I think we must start talking about ways to solve the crises we face at home and across the country.

\- **Increased domestic energy production, while also investing in renewable and alternative energy sources** ;
\- **Easing the regulatory burden on small businesses and franchisees** ;
\- **Expanding the R &D tax credit to encourage innovation**;
\- **Smashing China's stranglehold on the global supply chain by bringing manufacturing back to the US**

name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: Are you joining us at Netroots Nation? Register today and save.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
https://www.kpef.info/ [https://www.kpef.info/]

Dear Friend,

A quick reminder — Netroots Nation kicks off in one month on August 18 ! Keystone Progress will be there, and I hope you're planning to join us in Pittsburgh or virtually.

Registration rates will bump up on Wednesday — which is tomorrow! If you haven't registered yet, do it now to get the best price! [https://www.netrootsnation.org/register/?link_id=1&can_id=0883d8761d8a03e5f40df0d38b4e15ba&emci=89b6548d-8207-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
https://www.netrootsnation.org/register/?link_id=1&can_id=0883d8761d8a03e5f40df0d38b4e15ba [https://www.netrootsnation.org/register/?link_id=1&can_id=0883d8761d8a03e5f40df0d38b4e15ba]

We've got more than 140 breakout sessions on the agenda—panels, trainings, film screenings, professional development sessions, keynotes and more. And you'll find something on nearly every topic, from addressing gun violence and community safety to protecting abortion access and our democracy.

Wondering who's speaking? You'll hear from Rep. Ilhan Omar , Rep. Andy Levin , State Rep. Summer Lee , Pittsburgh Mayor Ed Gainey , Abigail Disney , International President of the Association of Flight Attendants Sara Nelson , AFT President Randi Weingarten , Pulse shooting survivor Brandon Wolfe , Daily Kos founder Markos Moulitsas , State Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta , State Rep. Sara Innamarato , State Sen. Lindsey Williams , Black Voters Matter co-founder LaTosha Brown , and more.

A ticket gets you access to all content — keynotes, panels, trainings, social events and more. But prices go up Wednesday, so click here to get your ticket today [https://www.netrootsnation.org/register/?link_id=1&can_id=0883d8761d8a03e5f40df0d38b4e15ba&emci=89b6548d-8207-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=] .

Can't make it to Pittsburgh but still want to join in on some of the fun? Virtual-only tickets will go on sale Wednesday. This ticket will get you access to about 40 hours of select content, plus you'll be able to connect with other attendees (both virtual and in-person) and our great sponsors via our app.

Looking forward to seeing you in one month!

Laura Nevitt
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

subject: Registering Kentucky to vote
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

$15.28.

That’s how much it costs our campaign to fund one voter registration team,
just $15.28.

This work is a critical part of our strategy to build the largest
organizing program Kentucky has seen and defeat Rand Paul. For too long,
the GOP has been able to defend their seats by leveraging voter
suppression tactics and discouraging folks from raising their voices.

We can end this cycle of failed leadership by making sure everyone from
the hood to the holler is registered to vote and turns out to vote for
real change this election. That’s why we’re reaching out to ask you for a
favor, Peter:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220719.L2Cnxb&refcode=em20220719-2245&t=1001&akid=2245%2E346206%2EuD8GxO ]Will you chip in $15.28 or anything you can today to support our
efforts to register voters in Kentucky and make sure our voices are heard
this election?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220719.L2Cnxb&refcode=em20220719-2245&t=1020&akid=2245%2E346206%2EuD8GxO ]CHIP IN NOW →

No one’s ever built a movement like this before in
Kentucky,
Peter.

Together, we are building the largest statewide deep organizing campaign
in Kentucky’s history. Our organizers are currently working in all 120
counties of Kentucky to make sure our campaign’s bold, progressive message
reaches every corner of our Commonwealth.

This includes inviting as many Kentuckians as possible to raise their
voices in this upcoming election — especially those who have been
historically disenfranchised from voting and folks who typically don’t
turn in big numbers in our elections.

For too long, there’s been this myth that Kentucky will forever be a red
state. But the truth is it’s a disenfranchised state. It’s a commonwealth
where a whole lot of people haven’t felt heard in a long time, and where
the number of people who don’t vote outnumber those who do. Mitch
McConnell and Rand Paul know this — so their plan is to continue dividing
us, distracting us from the common priorities we share, and discouraging
us from voting.

Their plan isn’t going to work this year. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220719.L2Cnxb&refcode=em20220719-2245&t=1021&akid=2245%2E346206%2EuD8GxO ]If you’re with us in this
fight to transform politics in Kentucky and send a champion for working
families to the U.S. Senate, please give $15.28 or anything you can today
to support our voter registration work.

Together,

Leo

Andy Levin has dedicated his life to organizing on the ground and fighting righteous fights — he is one of my strongest partners in Congress, and his voice is extremely valuable to our movement. His record speaks for itself:
When Amazon employees worked to unionize in Bessemer, Alabama, Andy was on the front lines fighting alongside them. He recently led the charge to allow congressional staffers. He was an original co-sponsor of the Green New Deal, he’s introduced bill after bill to make it a reality, and he’s brought over $6 million of Green New Deal project funding to Michigan.
Andy supports abolishing the filibuster and expanding and reforming the makeup of the Supreme Court, and with his help, Michigan received a record-breaking number of signatures to get a reproductive freedom initiative on the ballot. Just today he hit the streets of DC to protest for abortion rights. Andy's passionate, fearless leadership is necessary in Congress — and we can’t afford to lose his voice.
**We need our best fighters in the ring right now to fight for abortion rights, climate action, and an economy that works for working people — not just giant corporations. Andy Levin exemplifies that kind of fighter, and right now he needs all of our help to finish this race strong.**

| | Friend,**

** Laura Kelly’s leadership is failing Kansas. For the first time in generations, we’re losing population on her watch. She has no plan to grow Kansas. In fact, she continues to tout this Kansas economy as a “success.” The Kelly economy that has more than 27,000 fewer Kansans working than when she took over, has close to the smallest workforce participation since the Jimmy Carter era, and trails the rest of the country by 20 percent in pandemic job recovery - a success? She’s out of touch. So out of touch, in fact, she recently said “bring it on” when asked about the coming Biden recession because the first thing that comes to mind for her is how it will affect our state government. No matter how many Kansas families and workers will suffer. I wanted to make sure you saw Derek’s latest message. We have got to grow Kansas again - not grow our state government, but grow our _state_ , our economy and our population. And Derek has a plan to do it**.** **Right now, our retirees face one of the worst tax burdens in America.** So it’s no wonder they would rather move to another state to save money than stay here at home. When we are sworn in next year, we will eliminate all state income taxes on retirement benefits - including Social Security, pensions, and 401k’s. **We need your help to make it happen!**

| | Peter,

When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”

_I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House._

In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. **But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in.**

If we haven't met yet, [**I'm Nancy Mace**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=771cebc8290d421ab2bc444b3ea3ac82&_e=j07YFdM3IxzQtgRefW8Kd138Xzmsm-Tl444CkSkW7bzRPh0KW-Bv2Aoa_BSsvC0VgxNiu5d2omrn_0MGDZmGYZlsJ_6998bTTmhxEGIRHxo1j7cbpzvBHmEB3h7XmqnJBy6aRj18kUWmGLYvbAnyz8Has_-nyHMtoDqRXURhHCa0UjWK4h4ViutfHnH1AQACzJNwA78VcO89aBGjwdHrsWfqQA0VXInRp6FmoYlP6lTZgcK4sj7v03fUj-edAxB4h84G_xXDU78zcMX9xStOpIth_LzqZT8Eb5x-mRo1LyIq3n41mYyo3O386FmqZCP8xCKQvCEGe6wL-AH_n_z8xADKhTpx-gVa09Pq3dY-4lYmIBBDEFzbLxnhC9rfw7jDeo8QS5Byy4_ez0SJgu9H6COgTwW0yp_6IzvwVMZU2pl0WA9WpzkqB2jwSGWkzDnSfeMaLsbE-flwDZPx49imOg%3D%3D). I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America!

I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina.

In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red.

**I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as[we continue on the path to re-election](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=771cebc8290d421ab2bc444b3ea3ac82&_e=j07YFdM3IxzQtgRefW8Kd138Xzmsm-Tl444CkSkW7bzRPh0KW-Bv2Aoa_BSsvC0VgxNiu5d2omrn_0MGDZmGYZlsJ_6998bTTmhxEGIRHxo1j7cbpzvBHmEB3h7XmqnJBy6aRj18kUWmGLYvbAnyz8Has_-nyHMtoDqRXURhHCa0UjWK4h4ViutfHnH1AQACzJNwA78VcO89aBGjwdHrsWfqQA0VXInRp6FmoYlP6lTZgcK4sj7v03fUj-edAxB4B3mEDFymOeVrIk8oRCvNHipb7CZ4IJjt-eG83q7PxxFq5bqt9sL0abRrInfEksqUQOvG7JZ9SjOLX0LkYaiU2LxSVbmHP5tp8JEXWubJPVlw1mnUtcW0yyZLaOsOgKZrt5WbFDl2TSnuAxVEzjO93hVdjO1iCA_ApD9gVe0-ishUJCaW4cWpTDvDG6v4gM-lcsvO4AGSyT41pdPXRK95Qg%3D%3D).**

| | | Friends,

Throughout my service in the Kansas legislature and first term as Secretary of State, one of my top priorities has been supporting small businesses and entrepreneurs in our state.

In October 2019, I was proud to announce the launch of the Kansas Business One Stop - an interagency collaborate to streamline the business formation process and allow business owners to obtain and file documents in one place.

Additionally, my office is implementing legislation I introduced to allow businesses to file their annual reports on a biennial basis.

**Both efforts reflect my strong belief that business owners are better served by focusing on their business, rather than filing forms with the government.**

Looking forward, I am eager to expand these efforts and promote more efficiencies in state government. But to do that, I need your help.

Will you consider [contributing](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=dd1c985e07&e=e4cd931cf2) $50, $100, or more, to support our campaign?

clean_body: | | | | | | | Friends, Throughout my service in the Kansas legislature and first term as Secretary of State, one of my top priorities has been supporting small businesses and entrepreneurs in our state. In October 2019, I was proud to announce the launch of the Kansas Business One Stop - an interagency collaborate to streamline the business formation process and allow business owners to obtain and file documents in one place. Additionally, my office is implementing legislation I introduced to allow businesses to file their annual reports on a biennial basis. Both efforts reflect my strong belief that business owners are better served by focusing on their business, rather than filing forms with the government. Looking forward, I am eager to expand these efforts and promote more efficiencies in state government. But to do that, I need your help. | [ ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=BJAgHetUUIqrbBbKj3z09j9OpIZbBzc5g2-7VwfHf34&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_debate_v1&n=1)

Friend– In case you missed it, Democrats held another disastrous debate on Sunday. When they weren’t touting their radical proposals like nationalizing the oil industry, all five Democrats on the stage were quick to point out how families were struggling with issues like rising prices – but neglected to mention that their party is responsible. In case you missed Sunday’s trainwreck, here are the takeaways:
1. Democrats provided no real solutions to Wisconsinites’ top concern – inflation
2. It took less than 15 minutes for the Democrats to promote court packing
3. No candidate said whether they support ANY abortion restrictions
4. Every candidate failed to condemn Joe Biden for the reckless spending that led us to our current economic crisis

The message became clearer with every awkward pause, empty promise, and shift of blame: the winner of this debate was Senator Ron Johnson. While the Democrats scramble to prove who is the most-far left, Republicans are fighting back against Joe Biden’s failed agenda that has led to sky-high costs and rising crime. We can’t let the fringe-left Democrats win in November. **EVENT REMINDER:**

**[Join us online TOMORROW, Wednesday, July 20, 2022 at 7:00-7:45 PM ET to celebrate one whole year of breaking barriers for working-class progressives. Sign-up to attend now! >>

With our **_Barrier To Entry: One Year Anniversary VIRTUAL Event_** coming up TOMORROW, we thought it would be a great time to personally introduce (and re-introduce) ourselves before seeing you on screen tomorrow.

* * *
[](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=5db430ac38&e=007b353608) What started as a passion project led by a handful of young progressive women who were tired of seeing working-class candidates left behind has since turned into a ground-breaking, barrier-breaking movement. We believe that the Democratic political space should be lifting up the voices of women, low-income individuals, and BIPOC — but instead we continue to see out-of-touch, privileged, and corporate-funded leaders use their advantages to remain in power. Over the past year, B/E has built a coalition of grassroots supporters in our mission to create a more equitable, more inclusive government that reflects ALL people by providing critical funding, resources, and campaign infrastructure to candidates of marginalized communities and working-class backgrounds. **We are proud to be 100% women-led — by women of color, queer women, progressive women — who want to see change.**

** This online birthday bash is a special opportunity for the like-minded, passionate people of the B/E community to come together and champion our shared progressive values. We’ll be joined by staffers, candidates, and supporters to celebrate one year of breaking barriers together.

With our Barrier To Entry: One Year Anniversary VIRTUAL Event coming up TOMORROW, we thought it would be a great time to personally introduce (and re-introduce) ourselves before seeing you on screen tomorrow. What started as a passion project led by a handful of young progressive women who were tired of seeing working-class candidates left behind has since turned into a ground-breaking, barrier-breaking movement. We believe that the Democratic political space should be lifting up the voices of women, low-income individuals, and BIPOC — but instead we continue to see out-of-touch, privileged, and corporate-funded leaders use their advantages to remain in power. Over the past year, B/E has built a coalition of grassroots supporters in our mission to create a more equitable, more inclusive government that reflects ALL people by providing critical funding, resources, and campaign infrastructure to candidates of marginalized communities and working-class backgrounds. We are proud to be 100% women-led — by women of color, queer women, progressive women — who want to see change. As an important part of our team, we hope to get the chance to meet YOU , friends -- TOMORROW at 7:00-7:45 PM EST for our Barrier To Entry: One Year Anniversary VIRTUAL Event! This online birthday bash is a special opportunity for the like-minded, passionate people of the B/E community to come together and champion our shared progressive values. We’ll be joined by staffers, candidates, and supporters to celebrate one year of breaking barriers together. I want to sit down and take a moment to reach out to you, Peter. This has been an incredible journey so far and more than I could have ever imagined. When I first decided to run with the encouragement of my community and my family, I knew it wouldn’t be easy. But living in and growing up in South Texas, being so close to working-class families and immigrants, I saw first-hand the most urgent problems affecting our region today — and I couldn’t sit aside when our community was desperate for change. We started with just a handful of supporters, which then led to more and more as people heard about the movement we were building together. We made it through the runoff, and now I’m honored to be your Democratic nominee. **That is all thanks to you. Every single step of the way, supporters like you inspired me to keep fighting even when the going got tough.** Now, I’m depending on your support more than ever. We are going up against an opponent backed by more MAGA money than I could count and that means we are going to be hit hard with attacks from every direction. But I KNOW we can get through this together because we have something they don’t: the people-power to get it done. We aren’t going to compromise our values and continue fighting for affordable and accessible healthcare, a $15 minimum wage, energy-efficient systems, free public college and trade school, a welcoming environment at the border, and so much more. I’m ready to keep working hard for our families and communities. South Texas is ready for a new vision and leadership. [**But to get to Congress and continue our fight, I am going to need your help. Congressman Schrader joins former Governor Ted Kulongoski, former Senator Gordon Smith, former state Democratic Party Chair Margaret Carter, and former Republican gubernatorial candidate Knute Buehler in rejecting the extremes of the far-right and far-left by endorsing my maverick campaign. As we move into the final stretch of signature gathering and look toward a busy end of the summer with campaign events, I hope you will share with your friends the historic opportunity we have to move our state forward. Together, we can show the entrenched political parties that Oregon is ready for a truly independent leader. Thank you for your continued support. Betsy * Paid for by Run Betsy Run The Betsy Brigade needs you to recapture Oregon’s independent spirit. **$30 Million Funding for Riverside Community Projects**

I’m proud to announce I was able to secure **$30 million in funding for 15 important community development projects across Riverside.** This includes funding for projects that will support working families, jobs initiatives, healthcare, housing programs, and so much more.

This is a huge win for our growing community and I will continue fighting for these funds as the bill advances.

**Ending the Deportation of Veterans**

Here’s an issue that’s close to my heart: The cruel deportation of U.S. veterans. As Chair of the House Veterans committees and as the son of victims of forced Japanese internment camps, I have been committed to bringing our deported U.S. veterans home and preventing future deporations.

body:
Image of Olikara campaign logo with photo of Steven Olikara and link to campaign website:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/OfS%20logo%20w%20headshot.png]
[https://www.stevenolikara.com]

Dear Peter,

Thank you so much for helping our campaign qualify for the debate stage. Thanks to your support, we got to share our vision to get big money out of politics and make government work for all of us. You can watch a replay of the debate here [https://youtu.be/b_6gVXBdETg?t=305] .

We won the debate! We continue hearing from commentators and viewers about how impactful our presence was on stage. Now, with just a few weeks to go until the primary election, we have a chance to shock the world and win on August 9th.

Screenshot of Joe Zepecki on TMJ4 Morning News with link to video clip: https://youtu.be/4B5SiBvHZKE [https://youtu.be/4B5SiBvHZKE]

# Dear Peter,

_**There is still time left to vote!**_

Polls are open until 8:00 PM this evening, and _I'm asking for your vote_.

I am running for governor to stand up for every hardworking Marylander who is struggling to make ends meet.

I am running to represent every parent who demands their child get a world-class education to create a brighter future for their children.

I am fighting for the safety of our communities and the integrity of the officers that protect our families.

Friend – **I am so excited to be reaching out to you on behalf of my son, Marco Lopez, who's running for governor of Arizona.**
Fifty years ago, Marco's dad and I made the decision to move our family from Mexico to Arizona. We came here for the promise of greater opportunity – for the promise of Arizona. But I never could have imagined where that promise would take Marco.
**From becoming the mayor of our hometown of Nogales, Arizona, to serving in the Obama administration, Marco has always been a champion for the people of this state. And today, he's following in my footsteps – running his own small business and creating jobs and opportunities in his community. **

As a mother, I couldn't be more proud of Marco – and as an Arizonan, I couldn't be more excited for the vision he has for our great state. Whether it's defending voting rights, fixing our broken education system or increasing access to affordable health care, Marco is dedicated to making Arizona a state that works for _all_ people.
**But it won't be easy. He's running against a Trump-backed Republican – and she cares more about pushing her extremist agenda than fixing the problems of our state. Simply put, she's the exact _opposite_ of my son.**

That's why I'm reaching out to you today. Even though Marco fights day after day to make Arizona's promise a reality for everyone, he has many more fights ahead of him. And while our family has plenty of love and support to go around, he's counting on grassroots folks like you to help power this campaign to victory.

| | Fellow American,

When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”

_I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House._

In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. **But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in.**

If we haven't met yet, [**I'm Nancy Mace**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=88f86b8bcee84507971c60bfcaffc19d&_e=YQa-6X2-6LAbrFgIaKyMt5n3jZ1knEw1TEXgSOq4uOcJouE2VoTOVOn-KoxxoCfxIYHvonjB1Aqwf_582DybO7byHyKgRuSevp2qfRWfEP9cJztrukNRAk_UTPek53OksSviKFCSEk1pW3LtpX56dwGGJnh49r0nW0f3T_8zHjKwYXlCIiod391qJplz_adlqY8d6NjVnY5QzR0aP2kgXU5E-G7nlNtk1FRB_Goh68MaHBcEkvqQezpB7nXvPWHKVKbq8yi3vuKoTBjUxSLakvZj_JVGkAnw9FgeZTapzGCI1qNtMD2uM5NcpXFjWVhl53ctyKCxDLvNif-Y9TKkNKCrfrUpZckZ4Xgt2g0fgYRIRH5DPSH49iY8AuwPM_jseBqwsficfDyrB8uZzyMZc9VeKenC_S1HZACQHP0iiBDdYojcWTi-VaSMCVIM8aHMg30rbE5HjB6y8ZM1VnlwGA%3D%3D). I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America!

I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina.

In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red.

**I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as[we continue on the path to re-election](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=88f86b8bcee84507971c60bfcaffc19d&_e=YQa-6X2-6LAbrFgIaKyMt5n3jZ1knEw1TEXgSOq4uOcJouE2VoTOVOn-KoxxoCfxIYHvonjB1Aqwf_582DybO7byHyKgRuSevp2qfRWfEP9cJztrukNRAk_UTPek53OksSviKFCSEk1pW3LtpX56dwGGJnh49r0nW0f3T_8zHjKwYXlCIiod391qJplz_adlqY8d6NjVnY5QzR0aP2kgXU5E-G7nlNtk1FRB_Goh68MaHBcEkvqQezpB7nXvPWHKTPWLraly8rIOD_72R3H373Gkyo0HYqI7Ln7aeMUZ9R4uYHqbALB2S4Dw-hYB_O6QVokIVC7hCwse0sZ9xqKF6TdUa_B2eqEeqf20UV1w6HaCdYspno4vUL4Cw-rrFjBc_qiRfs1iDgSDOXmOkAK12f2bOZxBSl48G9u8vfwKJspQ6zRFUtcS6hcm_BOo_voWtx6m-EWervLZdWK59uqFGQ%3D%3D).**

There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, _let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress._

I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much.

I'm proud of my conservative record and I'm proud of delivering results day in and day out for the Lowcountry. I'm proud I've never voted to raise your taxes. And as the daughter of a veteran, I'm proud of the work I've done to help our veterans throughout South Carolina. **Serving the Lowcountry is the honor of my lifetime.**

clean_body: When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you’re going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”| | | | | | Fellow American, When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.” I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House. In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in. If we haven't met yet, . I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America! I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina. In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red. I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as. There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress. I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much. I'm proud of my conservative record and I'm proud of delivering results day in and day out for the Lowcountry. I'm proud I've never voted to raise your taxes. And as the daughter of a veteran, I'm proud of the work I've done to help our veterans throughout South Carolina. Serving the Lowcountry is the honor of my lifetime. What's happening in America right now is horrifying. Kids are being used as political pawns, radical liberal ideas are becoming mainstream, the woke media is prioritizing clicks and view over the truth, and our so-called ‘leaders' have sold themselves out for fame and fortune. As Americans, we deserve so much better than this. It's time to restore our economy, secure the southern border, put parents back in charge, support our military, and reestablish pride in our country. I'm in Washington week in and week out, fighting for you and your family – I have a 100% record of voting to lower taxes and a 100% lifetime rating with Conservation Voters of South Carolina! I'll leave you with this thought: I believe you can do anything you set your mind to. That's how a high-school drop-out like myself became a Congresswoman. I believe we can fix our country and leave a stronger nation to the next generation. Maybe it's how I was raised, or maybe it's just the fighting spirit in me, but I know we can fix the broken system in Washington. Thank you and God bless, Nancy Mace | | | About Nancy Congresswoman Nancy Mace grew up in the Lowcountry. She is the daughter of a retired Army General and retired school teacher. She is a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel’s Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America! name: Laurie Teper
subject: Checking In and Beach Vacation Opportunity
body:
Hello Team Geels!
**Are you tired of what is happening in our country? Is it affecting you personally? Do you agree we need to change course? Do you want to see Valerie Foushee defeated?**
**If you answered yes to any of these questions, we NEED YOU!** November seems far off but think about it....16 weeks away to accomplish the goal of flipping the seat RED! Do you want to play a role in making National News??

_IT 'S TIME!_
On a personal note, I was a person who _always voted and complained_. I was a person who _always voted and said no to volunteering._ I was a person who _always voted and said I hate politics._ I was a person who _always voted and contacted my legislators SOMETIMES_. I was a person who _always voted and said I did my part_. I was a person who _always voted....fill in the blank_. I finally woke up and said it's time! It's time to get involved if I want to see _CHANGE_ and know in my heart that I put in the effort. How about you? I want to remind you that the Courtney Geels Campaign is a _grassroots effort_! You are the core team of Courtney Geels for Congress supporters.

**PHONE CALLING STARTED AND WE STILL NEED HELP!**
The goal: Calling 34,305 inconsistent registered Republican voters to get them to commit to vote November 8. Thank you to those who are already doing this!!
* It's easy.
* Script provided.
* An opportunity to talk with those who answer the phone.
* An opportunity to leave a voicemail for those who don't answer. They will still hear your message.
* Think about the person who doesn't intend to vote until they hear about Courtney and what she stands for.
* Success is already happening!

**Door Knocking Begins July 30 in Alamance County! SAVE THE DATES**
Can you volunteer your time for 3 hours on a Saturday morning followed by lunch? We are going to homes that are registered Republicans and encouraging them to show up at the polls this November! In order to flip the seat RED, we need every registered Republican to VOTE!
It's pretty simple! See your county coordinator information listed below to sign up.
The following dates are scheduled for the other counties:
**Orange County - August 6**
**Granville County - August 13**
**Durham County - August 20**
**Person County - August 27**
**Alamance County - September 3**

**MORE VOLUNTEERS NEEDED!**
We need your help in getting more volunteers. _Please strive to get at least one friend, neighbor, co-worker or family member to join our team._ We need people to help in so many ways. Share this link with potential volunteers to sign up:
<https://courtneygeelsforcongress.com/volunteer/>

**FUNDING!**
Pure and simple: _the campaign needs money!_ Thank you to those who have already jumped in and are helping to fund the campaign. Courtney had a goal to get 1000 people to donate **$22 or more** every month through November. We are falling way short of that goal! If you haven't already done so, please consider joining that effort and share it with the same like-minded people as yourselves. Here is the link:
<https://secure.winred.com/courtney-geels-for-congress/donate-today>

Beach Vacation Raffle! _Another way to fund the campaign!_
Enter to win a 3-night stay in Emerald Isle, North Carolina (August 27th-30th, 2022) courtesy of Courtney Geels for Congress!

<https://secure.winred.com/courtney-geels-for-congress/beach-vacation-raffle>

**Fundraising Events** are scheduled in each county starting August 19 in Person County. Details will be sent out soon.

**Please mark your calendars for early voting October 20- November 5, and Election Day November 8th. We need all hands on deck. Contact your County Coordinator to volunteer!**

**
**
_Person_ : Jason Chambers - [JWCham8786@gmail.com](mailto:JWCham8786@gmail.com)
_Orange_ : LaRayne Quale - [LaRayne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:LaRayne@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
_Alamance_ : Corrie Shepherd - [Corrieshep@gmail.com](mailto:Corrieshep@gmail.com)
_Durham_ : Renee Hill - [rhill632@aol.com](mailto:rhill632@aol.com)
_Granville_ : Ron & Barb Conway - [rb_conway@msn.com](mailto:rb_conway@msn.com); [ron_conway@msn.com](mailto:ron_conway@msn.com)
**
**
Don 't hesitate to reach out with any questions.

May God look favorably on this campaign and protect you all!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper

If you answered yes to any of these questions, we NEED YOU! November seems far off but think about it....16 weeks away to accomplish the goal of flipping the seat RED! Do you want to play a role in making National News?? IT 'S TIME! On a personal note, I was a person who always voted and complained. I was a person who always voted and said no to volunteering. I was a person who always voted and said I hate politics. I was a person who always voted and contacted my legislators SOMETIMES. I was a person who always voted and said I did my part. I was a person who always voted....fill in the blank. I finally woke up and said it's time! It's time to get involved if I want to see CHANGE and know in my heart that I put in the effort. subject: Cori's opponent loaned himself $135K
body:
We can’t let a corporate Democrat backed by Wall Street who can loan his campaign $135,000 win this race.
#
Peter, we just learned that Cori’s main corporate-backed opponent loaned his own campaign $135,000. That’s on top of all the corporate PAC and Wall Street donations he’s taken.
Cori Bush’s primary is in exactly two weeks. **While her corporate opponent can reach into his own pocket to fund a TV ad blitz, Cori is relying on grassroots support to run the ads, knock the doors, and make the phone calls to win.**
[Rush a split donation to Cori and Justice Democrats now to keep Cori in Congress >>](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112231?refcode=em20220719-24360&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=24360%2E1203867%2Eyv-P8P)

Cori has been a strong progressive voice since day one. And because she’s an advocate for the people, she doesn’t take a cent of corporate PAC money. That’s why we’ve got to have her back down the final stretch of her primary campaign.
**Cori was our first ever JD recruit** ; we stood by her through two primary elections and she won big in 2020 with support from people like you, defeating an entrenched corporate incumbent.
**We can’t let the corporate-backed political establishment win this upcoming primary against Cori.** Cori is working-class, she worked as a nurse before getting elected to Congress, and she’s an activist. We can’t let a corporate Democrat backed by Wall Street who can loan his campaign $135,000 win this race. We must step up and support Cori right away.
[Peter, will you help us defeat Cori’s corporate-backed opponent on August 2nd by splitting a contribution between JD and Cori’s campaign right now?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112231?refcode=em20220719-24360&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=24360%2E1203867%2Eyv-P8P)
Cori’s team is working to reach voters across the district but they need the resources to hire more organizers, run more ads across the district, and Get Out The Vote for Cori. And they can only do it with your grassroots contributions.
Thank you so much for your support,
Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=23&akid=24360%2E1203867%2Eyv-P8P) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.
