Fellow American,

The news last week for our campaign was a mixed bag.

While we raised the most money last quarter of any non-incumbent Republican running for the Senate in the country, **our opponent raised $11 million more than us and has three times as much money in the bank.**

That's why I think it's sad he emails far-Left donors and _**falsely warns**_ them he may have to take his ads off TV because he doesn't have enough money to compete.

**In reality, our campaign is the one that cannot keep up with his record-setting fundraising machine of out-of-state money.**

Right now, we're having to make tough decisions about our advertising budget because we fell short of our fundraising goal last week. That means we can't talk to voters daily and set the record straight about the barrage of false attack ads that are currently airing.

Unfortunately, we're already falling short again this week, and without your immediate help - we're going to have to cut our advertising budget again.

| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

| | One of my opponents wants to suppress your vote.
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | I learned recently that one of the people on the ballot - a sham candidate who has never lived in what is now Congressional District 1 - has filed a sham lawsuit to take me off the ballot. She hired a former GOP state represenatative as her attorney and is invoking DeSantis' unconstitutional voter supression bill - SB90 - to steal the right of the people in our district to vote for the candidate they want. Why? Because she knew she would not win and only ever worked to get Matt Gaetz re-elected from the start. She filed to run against me in the Democratic primary after the new state maps were released, fully knowing she would be moved to District 2 once the maps were finalized. Having only lived in Florida all of two years, she decided not to run in her district, but instead to stay in mine. Since then, she has been caught lying and defaming me (making her the subject of a massive, 280-page ethics complaint against her which is currently with the state board of elections), working openly with Ron DeSantis' key staff members, including Christina Pushaw and Jeremy Redfern, and has been kicked out of club meetings for her unhinged attacks on me and the democratic party behind me. She has received no endorsements except one friend of hers and a guy who stalked and harassed me on Twitter for years. Seriously. Her campaign is so fake, they raised less than $5,000 all of last quarter, yet continue to spend tens of thousands more than that without disclosing who the money is coming from. I mostly ignored her because we all recognized the campaign for what it was - a sad joke meant to distract voters. Now, they've gone too far. Now, they don't want the voters to have a voice at all. This ridiculous lawsuit invokes one of DeSantis' most insane and unconstitutional new voter suppression laws - SB90 - which is currently the subject of a massive lawsuit led in party by Democratic Party allies. She claims that I shouldn't qualify for the ballot because I was briefly registered in another state (ya know, when I fled from tyranny with my family), and thus do not meet the requirement to be registered with the Florida Democratic Party for 365-days before June 10, 2022. It won't work. But that's not the point. Like her GOP collaborators, it's a tactic to get attention and distract the voters from the issues. The lawsuit would not be settled by next month and thus would have no impact on the upcoming primary that she knows she is going to lose. If she were somehow successful, Matt Gaetz would be running unopposed in November. And because the Gaetz empire here has always had a stranglehold on the media, they're giving her the attention. The reaction from the community was swift and clear. Endorsements from Dr. Cindy Banyai, Anthony Yantz, and Ryan Morales came in immediately. State officials circulated an email condemning the actions with DEC chairs across the state demanding the party take action. Rep. Katie Porter is working to get people across the state on our side. Nikki Fried's team was livid, mortified that a supposed Democrat would invoke SB90 to target the presumptive nominee in one of the most historic races in our state. She knows she will lose so she is trying to steal your vote and give it to Matt Gaetz. All of this happened right after her chief campaign orchestrator, a woman who also lives in District 2 named Samantha Herring, was caught on video during a racist tirade in which she went full BBQ-Becky on one of our party's most passionate and effective advocates. She wants the attention. Let's answer this attempt of election stealing by raising $50,000 before my birthday this Sunday and send a message to "Peggy," the GOP-obstructionists, and would-be election thieves that these tactics will not work in Florida - not today, tomorrow, or ever.

# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220719-3231-header&t=1&akid=3231%2E2526796%2ExUBd7q)
**Alexandria was just arrested by Capitol Police outside the Supreme Court during an abortion rights demonstration.** [Rush a $3 contribution to abortion access groups right now to show Congress we stand with AOC and #WeWontBackDown.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=abortion-aoc-email-20220719.3Cttmc&refcode=em20220719-3231-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3231%2E2526796%2ExUBd7q) **[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=abortion-aoc-email-20220719.3Cttmc&refcode=em20220719-3231-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3231%2E2526796%2ExUBd7q)**
---

There is so much at stake in a post-Roe United States. And it’s up to the President and the Democratic-majority in Congress to act NOW.
Alexandria understands the urgency, which is why today she joined organizers, activists, and 17 fellow members of Congress for an abortion rights demonstration outside the Supreme Court — where she was just arrested.
**Alexandria will not rest until Congress does what needs to be done to codify abortion care as a human right in our country.** [In the meantime, you can help folks seeking to access adortion care right now by splitting a $3 contribution to abortion access groups.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=abortion-aoc-email-20220719.3Cttmc&refcode=em20220719-3231-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3231%2E2526796%2ExUBd7q)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=abortion-aoc-email-20220719.3Cttmc&refcode=em20220719-3231-P_FND_RES_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3231%2E2526796%2ExUBd7q)**
_100% of your contribution will be split amongst these three groups: Kansans for Constitutional Freedom, Protect Kentucky Access, and Michigan Reproductive Freedom for All._
Since the Roe annoucement, Alexandria laid out a legislative action plan, started sharing information on how to access medical abortion on social media, and together with our movement has raised over $465,000 for five abortion funds across the country.
History shows that peaceful civil disobedience is an effective tool for movements to disrupt business as usual and demonstrate the moral imperative of the moment. Thank you to the organizers and activists with Center for Popular Democracy Action for leading this effort.
Together, we will keep fighting to protect abortion access and the right to bodily autonomy.
Thank you,
Team AOC
